items.title: 燁輝斥8.04億元認購燁聯私募股13.4萬張 持股比提升至35.46%
items.title_en: Yeh Hui Allocates NT$804 Million to Subscribe for 134,000 Private Placement Shares of Yeh Lian, Raising Stake to 35.46%
paras: 燁輝(2023-TW)今(23)日召開重訊，擬參與認購燁聯(9957-TW)私募普通股13.4萬張，每股私募價格6元，投資金額達8.04億元，燁輝目前對燁聯直接持股比例34.05%，本次認購完成後，持股比將升至35.46%。
燁輝表示，本次參與燁聯私募，資金將直接挹注燁聯鋼鐵推動「高效節能環保電爐」、「熱軋與冷軋產線現代化、自動化及智能建置」、「高值化產品組合與碳鋼產能擴大」，以及「提升綠能使用率與循環經濟」等重大改造計畫。
燁輝指出，透過資金支持燁聯上游產線現代化與節能升級，可確保燁聯生產的電爐熱軋鋼捲，在加工性、表面品質及鍍層附著力等方面，完全匹配燁輝高階鍍烤產品需求，進一步實現低碳排與高品質並存的競爭優勢。
此外，本次私募資金也將用於改善燁聯鋼鐵財務結構、降低利息負擔並增強營運韌性，燁輝表示，隨著燁聯獲利能力提升及營運規模擴大，也將直接反映於燁輝採權益法認列的轉投資收益，形成「上游營運改善、下游料源穩定、整體獲利回饋」的互惠綜效。
paras_en: Yeh Hui (2023‑TW) held a major announcement today (23rd), stating it intends to subscribe for 134,000 private‑placement ordinary shares of Yeh Lian (9957‑TW) at a private‑placement price of NT$6 per share, amounting to an investment of NT$804 million. Yeh Hui currently holds a direct stake of 34.05% in Yeh Lian; after this subscription is completed, its ownership will increase to 35.46%.

Yeh Hui said the funds from this private placement will be directly injected into Yeh Lian Steel to drive major transformation projects, including “high‑efficiency, energy‑saving, environmentally‑friendly electric furnaces,” “modernization, automation and intelligent construction of hot‑rolling and cold‑rolling production lines,” “high‑value product mix and expansion of carbon‑steel capacity,” as well as “enhancing green‑energy utilization and circular‑economy initiatives.”

Yeh Hui pointed out that by supporting the modernization and energy‑saving upgrades of Yeh Lian’s upstream production lines, it can ensure that the electric‑furnace hot‑rolled steel coils produced by Yeh Lian meet Yeh Hui’s high‑end coating product requirements in terms of formability, surface quality and coating adhesion, thereby creating a competitive advantage that combines low carbon emissions with high quality.

In addition, the private‑placement capital will be used to improve Yeh Lian Steel’s financial structure, reduce interest burdens and strengthen operational resilience. Yeh Hui said that as Yeh Lian’s profitability improves and its operational scale expands, the benefits will be directly reflected in Yeh Hui’s equity‑method recognized investment income, creating a mutually beneficial effect of “upstream operational improvement, downstream material supply stability, and overall profit feedback.”

items.title: 研華北美市場BB值逾2 產能供不應求爆滿到明年下半年
items.title_en: Advantech North America Market BB Ratio Exceeds 2, Capacity Shortage Full Through Mid‑Next Year
paras: 工業電腦大廠研華(2395-TW)北美區總經理牛文中今(23)日表示，研華前8月整體接單出貨比(BB Ratio)目前約1.4，但北美區高達2.15，且預計到年底仍維持在2左右，由於需求強勁，目前北美廠區產能滿載、供不應求，預期產能爆滿情況將延續至明年下半年。
牛文中表示，北美客戶對研華的要求已延伸至未來發展藍圖，公司已針對明、後年已提前規劃，因此今年上半年北美Design Win專案量已超越去年全年的4億美元，預計下半年將持平甚至有機會更多，今年全年Design Win專案量可望較去年增加1倍以上，持續挹注未來業績表現。
目前研華在美國共有3大主要生產與營運基地，分別位於伊利諾州Ottawa、北加州Milpitas，以及最新落成啟用的南加州Tustin。其中，過往作為主要生產據點的Milpitas目前已產能超載，Tustin則已有部分產線投產，陸續分擔專案訂單需求，營運總部預計10月下旬正式開幕。
牛文中進一步指出，Tustin今年預計產能達1億美元，但仍不足以因應需求，明年產能將提升至3億美元，並持續透過加班及加速將北加州產能調度至南加州，以填補訂單缺口，預期產能滿載、供不應求的情況要到明年下半年才會舒緩。因應長期需求，研華也規畫在南加州進一步購地，擴充生產基地。
在地製造方面，牛文中表示，北美製造可滿足客戶在地化、供應鏈韌性及縮短交期需求，隨邊緣AI成長，加上在地服務、法遵及美國政策法規，帶動在地製造需求。透過在地研發、製造及交付，研華可提供深度客製化與在地支援，尤其軍工、金融等高機密性產業對美國製造需求較高。
研華北美南加州新總部坐落於加州Tustin ATEP園區，占地10英畝，總樓地板面積18.9萬平方英尺，總部大樓樓高6層，整體投資金額超過1億美元，園區涵蓋辦公室、組裝製造中心、倉儲、展示中心(Demo Room)及會議中心，新總部定位為商業與營運核心。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395‑TW) North America regional manager Niu Wen‑zhong said on the 23rd that Advantech’s overall BB Ratio for the first eight months is about 1.4, but it reaches 2.15 in North America and is expected to stay around 2 through year‑end. Because demand is strong, the North American plants are running at full capacity and supply cannot meet demand, and this capacity crunch is expected to last until the second half of next year.

Niu explained that North American customers’ requirements now extend to future development roadmaps, and the company has already planned ahead for the next two years. Consequently, the Design‑Win project volume in North America in the first half of this year already surpassed the full‑year $400 million of last year, and the second half is expected to be flat or even higher. The total Design‑Win volume for the year could be more than double last year’s, continuously feeding future performance.

Advantech currently operates three major production and operations sites in the United States: Ottawa, Illinois; Milpitas in Northern California; and the newly completed Tustin site in Southern California. Milpitas, formerly the main production hub, is now over‑capacity, while Tustin has already brought some production lines online to gradually share the project order load, with the operations headquarters slated to officially open in late October.

Niu added that Tustin is expected to reach a production capacity of $100 million this year, which is still insufficient for demand. Capacity will be raised to $300 million next year, and the company will continue to use overtime and accelerate the shift of Northern California capacity to Southern California to fill the order gap. The situation of full capacity and supply shortage is not expected to ease until the second half of next year. To meet long‑term demand, Advantech also plans to purchase additional land in Southern California to expand the plant.

Regarding local manufacturing, Niu said that North American production can satisfy customers’ needs for localization, supply‑chain resilience and shorter lead times. With the growth of edge AI, together with local services, regulatory compliance and U.S. policy requirements, demand for domestic manufacturing is being driven. Through local R&D, manufacturing and delivery, Advantech can provide deep customization and on‑site support, especially for high‑confidentiality sectors such as defense and finance that have strong demand for U.S.‑made products.

Advantech’s new North America headquarters in Southern California is located in the ATEP campus in Tustin, California, covering 10 acres with a total floor area of 189,000 square feet across six stories. The overall investment exceeds $100 million. The campus includes offices, an assembly‑manufacturing center, warehousing, a demo room and a conference center, positioning the new headquarters as the core of its commercial and operational activities.

items.title: 休市錯過全球AI大漲？日股周四開盤拚補漲
items.title_en: Missed the Global AI Surge During the Holiday? Japanese Stocks Aim to Recover on Thursday Opening
paras: 日本股市結束「白銀周」連假，周四(24日)恢復交易。全球人工智慧(AI)概念股本周重拾漲勢，日股有望補漲；但日元持續走貶，也讓市場緊盯日本當局是否干預匯市。大阪交易的日經225指數12月期貨，已較上周五現貨收盤水準高出約2.5%。日本公債則受油價下跌與日銀(日本央行/BOJ)升息前景牽動，走勢較難判斷。

AI熱潮再起 半導體股可望領漲

Meta Platforms(META-US)新推出的AI代理初步展現成效，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)也發表號稱中國性能最強的AI晶片，帶動全球AI交易回溫。此前美國主要AI業者呼籲放慢開發速度，一度令市場擔憂產業成長；如今美股那斯達克100指數周二在晶片股帶動下，創下6月以來首個新高。

Vantage Global Prime分析師Hebe Chen指出，AI股反彈、風險情緒改善與油價回落，為日股提供補漲空間，也暫緩通膨與利率壓力。iFast Financial分析師Hu You預期，東京威力科創(8035-JP)、愛德萬測試(6857-JP)等晶片設備商可望受惠，揖斐電(IBIDEN)(4062-JP)與鎧俠(285A-JP)也可能走高。日經225指數截至9月18日的五個交易日上漲1.6%，為約一個月來最佳單周表現。

日元連貶添干預變數 債市觀望日銀

日銀上周五升息，並表明仍可能進一步緊縮，但欠缺明確指引，令日元交易員失望。日元當天一度貶1.3%至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後因《日本經濟新聞》報導日銀向市場詢問匯價而收斂跌幅。詢價常被視為可能干預的前兆，但賣壓其後再起。日元周三東京時間傍晚報157.88，朝連跌第四天邁進，若成真將是8月下旬以來最長連跌；選擇權市場也顯示，投資人加強防範干預後日元反彈。
布蘭特原油跌破每桶100美元、美國公債殖利率本周走低，原可支撐日債，日銀政策的不確定性卻可能抵銷利多。Hu You認為，升息墊高短期利率底部，短天期日債價格將承壓。《彭博》經濟學家木村太郎指出，日銀總裁植田和男態度比預期更鷹派，強調基礎通膨正接近2%目標，卻鮮少談及疲弱日元。
本周川普與中國國家主席習近平的會晤，也是市場焦點。Chen提醒，日元貶值起初有利出口股，若持續推升通膨與升息預期，日債恐再度承壓。
paras_en: Japan's stock market resumes trading on Thursday (the 24th) after the "Silver Week" holiday. Global AI‑related stocks have reclaimed their upward momentum this week, giving Japanese equities a chance to catch up; however, the yen’s continued depreciation keeps the market watching to see whether Japanese authorities will intervene in the FX market. Osaka‑traded December Nikkei 225 futures are about 2.5% higher than the spot closing level on Friday. Japanese government bonds are harder to read, being influenced by falling oil prices and the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) tightening outlook.

The AI boom is back, and semiconductor stocks are set to lead the rally. Meta Platforms (META‑US) has rolled out a new AI assistant that is already showing results, and Alibaba (BABA‑US) announced what it claims is China’s most powerful AI chip, reviving global AI trading activity. Earlier, major U.S. AI firms had urged a slowdown in development, sparking concerns about industry growth; now, the Nasdaq‑100 hit its first new high since June on Tuesday, driven by chip stocks.

Vantage Global Prime analyst Hebe Chen notes that the rebound in AI stocks, improved risk sentiment and lower oil prices give Japanese equities room to recover and temporarily ease inflation and rate pressures. iFast Financial analyst Hu You expects chip‑equipment makers such as Tokyo‑based Tokyo Electron (8035‑JP) and Advantest (6857‑JP) to benefit, while IBIDEN (4062‑JP) and KAI‑X (285A‑JP) could also rise. The Nikkei 225 had risen 1.6% over the five trading days ending September 18, its best weekly performance in about a month.

The yen’s continued slide adds an intervention variable, leaving the bond market on hold for the BOJ. The BOJ raised rates last Friday and signaled that further tightening is possible, but offered no clear guidance, disappointing yen traders. The currency fell as much as 1.3% that day to ¥158.05 per dollar before retracing after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had queried the market on exchange rates – a move often seen as a pre‑emptive sign of possible intervention, though selling pressure resumed afterward. By Wednesday evening Tokyo time the yen was at ¥157.88, marking a fourth consecutive decline and potentially the longest streak since late August; options markets also show investors hedging against a post‑intervention yen rebound.

Brent crude slipped below $100 a barrel and U.S. Treasury yields fell this week, which could have supported Japanese bonds, but uncertainty around BOJ policy may offset the upside. Hu You believes that rate hikes have lifted the short‑term rate floor, putting pressure on short‑dated Japanese bond prices. Bloomberg economist Taro Kimura points out that BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda’s stance is more hawkish than expected, emphasizing that core inflation is nearing the 2% target while giving little comment on the weak yen.

This week’s meeting between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping is also a market focus. Chen warns that an initially export‑friendly yen depreciation could, if it persists, push up inflation and rate‑hike expectations, putting Japanese bonds under renewed pressure.

items.title: 散戶大軍回神！8月證券劃撥存款餘額飆破4.5兆元 創歷史新高
items.title_en: Retail Investors Rally! August Securities Transfer Deposit Balance Surges Past NT$4.5 Trillion, Hitting a Historic High
paras: 台灣央行今(23)日公布7月國內金融情況，一向被視為「散戶風向球」的證券劃撥存款餘額較上月飆增3889億元至4兆5712億元，創歷史新高，單月增加3889億元也創史上最大增額，同時，8月台股融資餘額增至7589億元，創單月次高，僅次於6月。
央行說明，證券劃撥存款餘額「處於蠻高水準」，反映投資人信心升溫，散戶8月在台股的成交占比從上月的48.9%回升至50.9%，而本國法人由12%降至 10.2%，僑外法人降至38.8%。
此外，由於AI相關電子出口相當暢旺，廠商收取貨款，使8月外匯存款期底餘額升至9兆6488億元，較上月續增566億元，並續創歷史新高。
另一方面，央行8月日平均貨幣總計數M1B和M2年增率分別下降為6.65%、6.79%，其中，M2年增率下降主要因外匯存款及活期儲蓄存款成長減緩；累計前8月平均M1B及M2年增率分別為7.71%、6.62%。
央行進一步提到，8月全體貨幣機構放款與投資期底餘額共57.4兆元，年增9.43%，創27年半來最大增幅，主要AI強勁需求下，製造業購地、建廠、購料等資金需求增加。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan released July domestic financial data today (23rd), showing that the securities transfer deposit balance—often seen as the "retail investor barometer"—jumped by NT$388.9 billion from the previous month to NT$4,571.2 billion, a historic peak. The monthly increase of NT$388.9 billion also marks the largest rise ever recorded, while August margin financing balances rose to NT$758.9 billion, the second‑largest monthly total after June.

The bank explained that the securities transfer deposit balance is "at a fairly high level," reflecting warming investor confidence. Retail investors' share of Taiwan‑stock trading rose from 48.9% in the prior month to 50.9% in August, while domestic institutional investors fell from 12% to 10.2% and foreign institutional investors dropped to 38.8%.

In addition, strong exports of AI‑related electronics boosted manufacturers' cash receipts, pushing the end‑of‑month foreign‑exchange deposit balance up to NT$9,648.8 billion in August, an increase of NT$56.6 billion from the previous month and a new historical high.

On the other hand, the central bank reported that the average daily M1B and M2 growth rates for August fell to 6.65% and 6.79% year‑over‑year, respectively. The slowdown in M2 growth was mainly due to a deceleration in foreign‑exchange deposits and demand‑deposit growth; the cumulative average growth rates for the first eight months were 7.71% for M1B and 6.62% for M2.

The bank further noted that total loans and investment balances across all monetary institutions reached NT$57.4 trillion at the end of August, a 9.43% year‑over‑year increase—the largest rise in 27½ years—driven by strong AI demand that spurred manufacturing firms to spend on land acquisition, plant construction, and material purchases.

items.title: 台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Valuation Hits $5.3 Trillion, Overtakes India to Rank 4th Globally; TSMC Contributes Over NT$1 Trillion in One Day
paras: 台股今(23)日開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。
根據國際財經數據網站《MarketCapWatch》截至今日下午 5 時的最新統計，台灣股市總市值達到約 5.3 兆美元，正式超越印度的 4.94 兆美元，榮登全球第 4 大股票市場。目前全球前三大股市分別為美國 82.7 兆美元、中國 21.22 兆美元及日本 8.59 兆美元。
全球第 6 至 10 名的資本市場，依序為英國 4.86 兆美元、韓國 4.5 兆美元、加拿大 4.45 兆美元、法國 3.08 兆美元以及德國 3 兆美元。台股不僅展現強勁的本土資金動能，在全球資本市場的戰略地位亦大幅提升。
台股這波市值暴衝的核心引擎即為權王台積電(2330-TW)，今日股價收在 2,500 元、大漲 40 元，市值衝高至 64.83 兆元，單日狂增約 1 兆元，不但為台股創高奠定基石，台積美元計算的市值2.05兆美元，也在《MarketCapWatch》全球個股市值中排名第7名。與排名第6的SpaceX(SPCX-US)市值2.08兆美元相去不遠。
在半導體與 AI 供應鏈族群拉抬下，上市前二十大個股排名也出現顯著變化，ABF 載板廠欣興(3037-TW)上漲 40 元收在 1,160 元，市值激增 655 億元，站上 1.9 兆元，並成功攀升至第 9 名，將南亞(1303-TW)擠至第 10 名。
散熱龍頭奇鋐(3017-TW)市值上揚314億元、來到 1.36 兆元，名次超越中信金(2891-TW)前進至第 15 名；被動元件大廠國巨*(2327-TW)市值小幅回升，超越緯穎(6669-TW)名列第 18 名。
傳產、金融族群今天普遍面臨回檔，南亞(1303-TW)市值縮水 317 億元；高價股川湖(2059-TW)大跌 280 元收在 12,390 元，市值下修至 1.18 兆元，為上市前二十大中跌幅最深個股。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened higher today (23rd) and, despite trading in a high‑range oscillation, ended up up 357.12 points, closing at 48,157.29 points, again setting a fresh all‑time high. Taiwan’s capital market achieved a historic breakthrough, with total market cap soaring to about $5.3 trillion, surpassing India for the first time and moving into the world’s fourth‑largest stock market. The biggest contributor was the “national guardian” TSMC, which alone added more than NT$1 trillion to market value in a single day.

According to the international finance data site MarketCapWatch, the latest figures as of 5 p.m. today show Taiwan’s total stock market value at roughly $5.3 trillion, officially overtaking India’s $4.94 trillion and claiming the fourth‑largest spot globally. The top three markets remain the United States at $82.7 trillion, China at $21.22 trillion and Japan at $8.59 trillion.

The world’s sixth‑through‑tenth‑largest capital markets are, in order, the United Kingdom ($4.86 trillion), South Korea ($4.5 trillion), Canada ($4.45 trillion), France ($3.08 trillion) and Germany ($3 trillion). Taiwan’s market not only shows strong domestic capital momentum but also markedly improves its strategic standing in the global capital arena.

The engine behind this market‑cap surge is the heavyweight TSMC (2330‑TW). Its share price closed at NT$2,500, up NT$40, pushing its market cap to NT$64.83 trillion – an increase of about NT$1 trillion in a single day. This not only laid the foundation for the market’s new high, but TSMC’s dollar‑denominated market cap of $2.05 trillion ranks it seventh worldwide on MarketCapWatch, close behind the sixth‑ranked SpaceX (SPCX‑US) at $2.08 trillion.

Riding the semiconductor and AI supply‑chain rally, the top‑20 listed stocks saw notable reshuffling. PCB maker Xinte (3037‑TW) rose NT$40 to close at NT$1,160, boosting its market cap by NT$65.5 billion to NT$1.9 trillion and climbing to the ninth spot, pushing Nanya (1303‑TW) down to tenth place.

Thermal‑solution leader Qihong (3017‑TW) saw its market cap rise NT$31.4 billion to NT$1.36 trillion, overtaking CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) to move up to the 15th position. Passive‑component giant Yageo (2327‑TW) saw a modest market‑cap rebound, surpassing Weiying (6669‑TW) to rank 18th.

Traditional industry and financial stocks generally faced pull‑backs today. Nanya’s market cap shrank by NT$31.7 billion; high‑price stock Chuanhu (2059‑TW) plunged NT$280 to close at NT$12,390, reducing its market cap to NT$1.18 trillion, making it the steepest‑declining stock among the pre‑listing top‑20.

items.title: 川普威脅毀滅伊朗 又稱會談良好 伊朗回應：說明美國陷入絕境
items.title_en: Trump Threatens Iran’s Destruction, Claims Talks Were Good; Iran Responds: America Is in a Dire Situation
paras: 美國總統川普於聯合國大會發表演說，對伊朗發出極端警告，稱伊朗正面臨「偉大或徹底毀滅」的選擇，若未達成協議將短時間內「毀滅」伊朗，並重申絕不允許伊朗取得核武。
然而在演說後，川普卻向媒體透露，美方特使威特考夫(Steve Witkoff)與庫許納(Jared Kushner)已在場邊與伊朗外交部長阿拉格奇(Abbas Araghchi)等人舉行長達三小時「非常好且具建設性」的會談，並預告近期將再次會晤。
面對美方言論，伊朗官方與軍方強硬反駁。伊朗武裝部隊總參謀部發表聲明，指責川普企圖為侵略辯護，其咆哮正顯示美國對伊朗的侵略已面臨「戰略死胡同」與「絕望」。
另一方面，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)地面部隊司令卡拉米少將(Mohammad Karami)強調，伊朗「絕不會向敵人退讓半步」，將持續堅持抵抗。
針對重啟荷姆茲海峽，伊朗官員堅持美方必須立即解除制裁、停止海上封鎖並解凍資產，並提議若美方減輕軍事壓力，可在七天內解除海峽封鎖。
對於川普的威脅言論，半島電視台美國首席特派員Alan Fisher指出，這種強硬威脅與秘密談判並存呈現「奇特並置」，但也散發出邁向和平協議的樂觀氣氛。
阿拉伯觀點研究所創辦主任Zeidon Alkinani表示，川普自開戰以來發言極具矛盾，作為「交易型人物」，若無法依其條件達成協議便威脅開戰；而美方在與以色列發動戰爭後，正迫切尋求能向國內與國際宣傳的「象徵性勝利」。
國際特赦組織秘書長Agnes Callamard不滿川普的說法，她認為，威脅消滅整個國家人口「已可能構成國際法上的種族滅絕威脅」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a speech at the United Nations General Assembly, issuing an extreme warning to Iran and saying the country faces a choice between "greatness or total destruction"; if an agreement is not reached, he warned that Iran would be "destroyed" in a short period and reiterated that the United States will never allow Iran to acquire nuclear weapons.

After the speech, however, Trump told the media that U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had held a three‑hour "very good and constructive" meeting on the sidelines with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and others, and announced that they would meet again soon.

In response to the U.S. statements, Iran’s officials and military issued a forceful rebuttal. The General Staff of the Iranian Armed Forces released a statement accusing Trump of trying to justify aggression, saying his roar shows that U.S. aggression toward Iran has reached a "strategic dead end" and "despair."

Meanwhile, Major General Mohammad Karami, commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) ground forces, stressed that Iran "will not concede a single step to the enemy" and will continue to resist.

Regarding the reopening of the Hormuz Strait, Iranian officials insisted that the United States must immediately lift sanctions, end the maritime blockade and unfreeze assets, and suggested that if the U.S. eases military pressure, the blockade could be lifted within seven days.

Commenting on Trump’s threatening remarks, Alan Fisher, Al Jazeera’s chief U.S. correspondent, said the coexistence of hard‑line threats and secret negotiations creates a "strange juxtaposition," but also emits an optimistic atmosphere toward a peace agreement.

Zeidon Alkinani, founder and director of the Arab Viewpoint Institute, said Trump’s statements have been highly contradictory since the war began; as a "transactional figure," he threatens war when his conditions are not met, and after the U.S. launched a war with Israel, it is now urgently seeking a "symbolic victory" to promote domestically and internationally.

Amnesty International Secretary‑General Agnes Callamard expressed displeasure with Trump’s remarks, stating that threatening to wipe out an entire nation’s population "could already constitute a threat of genocide under international law."

items.title: 油價飆也擋不住！歐元區9月企業活動創逾三年新高 ECB下月再升息有底氣
items.title_en: Rising Oil Prices Can't Stop It! Eurozone September Business Activity Hits Over Three-Year High, Giving ECB Confidence for Another Rate Hike Next Month
paras: 歐元區9月民間企業活動意外加速，擴張速度創逾三年新高。服務業回溫，加上製造業持續成長，顯示經濟迄今仍能抵禦美伊戰爭推升能源價格的衝擊，但企業成本與物價壓力同步上升，也讓歐洲央行(ECB)再度升息的可能性提高。
綜合外媒周三(23日)報導，標普全球(S&P Global)公布，歐元區9月綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)初值由8月的52.0升至53.1，為2023年4月以來最高，優於市場預期的51.7。指數高於50代表企業活動擴張。
服務業PMI由51.6升至53.0，創近一年新高，原先市場預期會降至51.5；製造業PMI則持平於52.7，但納入綜合指數的製造業產出指標由53.3小升至53.4。整體新訂單以逾四年來最快速度增加，出口訂單也持續成長，帶動企業增聘人手。
歐元區兩大經濟體表現也優於預期。德國企業活動擴張速度為2025年10月以來最快，法國則意外寫下逾兩年來最強勁的成長。標普全球首席商業經濟學家威廉森(Chris Williamson)表示，AI與國防支出帶動以德國為首的製造業，服務業也開始回溫，反映經濟改善範圍擴大。
然而，能源漲價正推高企業投入成本，部分業者已將成本轉嫁給客戶。威廉森指出，9月通膨壓力再起並不令人意外；經濟在地緣政治風險與物價上漲下保持韌性，可能讓ECB更有信心在年底前再度升息，10月升息也已成為可能選項。
ECB本月已升息，為美伊戰爭爆發後第二次，並將今年歐元區成長預測上修至0.9%。經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)周三也將歐元區2026年成長預測上調0.2個百分點至1%，但下修法國預測至僅成長0.4%。《彭博》經濟研究則預期，ECB將於12月進行最後一次升息。
paras_en: Eurozone private sector activity accelerated unexpectedly in September, with expansion reaching a three‑year high. A warming services sector and continued growth in manufacturing show the economy can still withstand the shock of higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war, but rising corporate costs and price pressures also increase the likelihood of another ECB rate hike.

According to a composite report from S&P Global on Wednesday (the 23rd), the Eurozone’s flash composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for September rose from 52.0 in August to 53.1, the highest since April 2023 and above the market forecast of 51.7. A reading above 50 indicates expansion in business activity.

The services PMI climbed from 51.6 to 53.0, a near‑year high, while the market had expected it to fall to 51.5; the manufacturing PMI held steady at 52.7, and the manufacturing output component of the composite index edged up from 53.3 to 53.4. Overall, new orders grew at the fastest pace in more than four years, export orders kept rising, and firms are hiring more staff.

The two biggest Eurozone economies also outperformed expectations. German business activity expanded at the fastest rate since October 2025, and France posted its strongest growth in over two years. S&P Global chief business economist Chris Williamson said AI and defence spending are driving manufacturing led by Germany, while services are beginning to recover, reflecting a broader economic improvement.

However, higher energy prices are pushing up corporate input costs, and some firms have already passed these costs onto customers. Williamson noted that a resurgence of inflationary pressure in September is not surprising; the economy’s resilience amid geopolitical risk and price hikes could give the ECB more confidence to raise rates again before year‑end, making an October hike a plausible option.

The ECB raised rates this month, its second hike since the outbreak of the US‑Iran conflict, and upgraded its 2024 Eurozone growth forecast to 0.9%. The OECD also lifted its 2026 Eurozone growth projection by 0.2 percentage points to 1% on Wednesday, while cutting France’s forecast to just 0.4% growth. Bloomberg Economics expects the ECB’s final rate hike to come in December.

items.title: 印尼央行維持基準利率5.75%不變 擴大避險誘因以穩定印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Keeps Benchmark Rate at 5.75% to Expand Hedging Incentives and Stabilize the Rupiah
paras: 印尼央行周三(23日)宣布將基準利率(7天期逆回購利率)維持在5.75%，為連續第三次按兵不動。隔夜存款利率與貸款利率分別維持於4.75%及6.5%。這是Destry Damayanti就任印尼央行首位女性總裁後的首次政策會議，決議符合市場預期。
印尼央行曾在今年5月與6月累計升息100個基點以捍衛匯率。總裁Damayanti表示，當前政策旨在維持印尼盾穩定、控制通膨並支撐經濟成長。
面對中東局勢、油價漲破每桶100美元及聯準會可能升息等外部不確定性，央行選擇採取非利率的創新政策工具，進一步調降外資避險成本(避險換匯貼息調降最高25%、國內無本金交割遠期外匯調降最高30%)，並採取「資金停留愈久、優惠愈高」的機制吸引外資流入。
決議公布後，印尼盾升值約0.4%至17,800對美元，股市大漲1.5%。
印尼8月通膨率升至3.19%，仍處於1.5%至3.5%的目標區間；央行維持2026年GDP成長預測於4.9%至5.7%不變。
市場對後續走勢看法分歧，巴克萊銀行預期利率將一路凍漲至2027年，但也有分析師認為，若高油價與聯準會升息壓力持續，央行第四季仍可能追加升息25個基點。
paras_en: Indonesia’s central bank on Wednesday (the 23rd) announced that it will keep the benchmark rate (the 7‑day reverse‑repo rate) at 5.75%, marking the third consecutive meeting of a hold. The overnight deposit rate and loan rate remain at 4.75% and 6.5% respectively. This was the first policy meeting after Destry Damayanti became the bank’s first female governor, and the decision matched market expectations.

The bank had raised rates by a total of 100 basis points in May and June of this year to defend the exchange rate. Governor Damayanti said the current policy aims to keep the rupiah stable, contain inflation and support economic growth.

Facing external uncertainties such as the Middle‑East situation, oil prices breaking $100 a barrel and the possibility of further Fed hikes, the central bank chose to use non‑rate innovative tools, further lowering the cost of hedging for foreign investors (reducing hedging‑exchange premium by up to 25% and domestic non‑deliverable forward premiums by up to 30%) and adopting a “the longer the funds stay, the higher the incentive” mechanism to attract foreign inflows.
After the decision was announced, the rupiah appreciated about 0.4% to around 17,800 per US dollar, and the stock market jumped 1.5%.
Indonesia’s August inflation rose to 3.19%, still within the 1.5%‑3.5% target band; the central bank kept its 2026 GDP growth forecast unchanged at 4.9%‑5.7%.

Market views on the next move diverge: Barclays expects rates to stay frozen until 2027, while some analysts argue that if high oil prices and Fed‑rate pressure persist, the bank could still add a 25‑basis‑point hike in the fourth quarter.

items.title: 燁輝斥8.04億元認購燁聯私募股13.4萬張 持股比提升至35.46%
items.title_en: Yeh Hui Allocates NT$804 Million to Subscribe for 134,000 Private Placement Shares of Yeh Lian, Raising Stake to 35.46%
paras: 燁輝(2023-TW)今(23)日召開重訊，擬參與認購燁聯(9957-TW)私募普通股13.4萬張，每股私募價格6元，投資金額達8.04億元，燁輝目前對燁聯直接持股比例34.05%，本次認購完成後，持股比將升至35.46%。
燁輝表示，本次參與燁聯私募，資金將直接挹注燁聯鋼鐵推動「高效節能環保電爐」、「熱軋與冷軋產線現代化、自動化及智能建置」、「高值化產品組合與碳鋼產能擴大」，以及「提升綠能使用率與循環經濟」等重大改造計畫。
燁輝指出，透過資金支持燁聯上游產線現代化與節能升級，可確保燁聯生產的電爐熱軋鋼捲，在加工性、表面品質及鍍層附著力等方面，完全匹配燁輝高階鍍烤產品需求，進一步實現低碳排與高品質並存的競爭優勢。
此外，本次私募資金也將用於改善燁聯鋼鐵財務結構、降低利息負擔並增強營運韌性，燁輝表示，隨著燁聯獲利能力提升及營運規模擴大，也將直接反映於燁輝採權益法認列的轉投資收益，形成「上游營運改善、下游料源穩定、整體獲利回饋」的互惠綜效。
paras_en: Yeh Hui (2023‑TW) held a major announcement today (23rd), stating it intends to subscribe for 134,000 private‑placement ordinary shares of Yeh Lian (9957‑TW) at a private‑placement price of NT$6 per share, amounting to an investment of NT$804 million. Yeh Hui currently holds a direct stake of 34.05% in Yeh Lian; after this subscription is completed, its ownership will increase to 35.46%.

Yeh Hui said the funds from this private placement will be directly injected into Yeh Lian Steel to drive major transformation projects, including “high‑efficiency, energy‑saving, environmentally‑friendly electric furnaces,” “modernization, automation and intelligent construction of hot‑rolling and cold‑rolling production lines,” “high‑value product mix and expansion of carbon‑steel capacity,” as well as “enhancing green‑energy utilization and circular‑economy initiatives.”

Yeh Hui pointed out that by supporting the modernization and energy‑saving upgrades of Yeh Lian’s upstream production lines, it can ensure that the electric‑furnace hot‑rolled steel coils produced by Yeh Lian meet Yeh Hui’s high‑end coating product requirements in terms of formability, surface quality and coating adhesion, thereby creating a competitive advantage that combines low carbon emissions with high quality.

In addition, the private‑placement capital will be used to improve Yeh Lian Steel’s financial structure, reduce interest burdens and strengthen operational resilience. Yeh Hui said that as Yeh Lian’s profitability improves and its operational scale expands, the benefits will be directly reflected in Yeh Hui’s equity‑method recognized investment income, creating a mutually beneficial effect of “upstream operational improvement, downstream material supply stability, and overall profit feedback.”

items.title: 研華北美市場BB值逾2 產能供不應求爆滿到明年下半年
items.title_en: Advantech North America Market BB Ratio Exceeds 2, Capacity Shortage Full Through Mid‑Next Year
paras: 工業電腦大廠研華(2395-TW)北美區總經理牛文中今(23)日表示，研華前8月整體接單出貨比(BB Ratio)目前約1.4，但北美區高達2.15，且預計到年底仍維持在2左右，由於需求強勁，目前北美廠區產能滿載、供不應求，預期產能爆滿情況將延續至明年下半年。
牛文中表示，北美客戶對研華的要求已延伸至未來發展藍圖，公司已針對明、後年已提前規劃，因此今年上半年北美Design Win專案量已超越去年全年的4億美元，預計下半年將持平甚至有機會更多，今年全年Design Win專案量可望較去年增加1倍以上，持續挹注未來業績表現。
目前研華在美國共有3大主要生產與營運基地，分別位於伊利諾州Ottawa、北加州Milpitas，以及最新落成啟用的南加州Tustin。其中，過往作為主要生產據點的Milpitas目前已產能超載，Tustin則已有部分產線投產，陸續分擔專案訂單需求，營運總部預計10月下旬正式開幕。
牛文中進一步指出，Tustin今年預計產能達1億美元，但仍不足以因應需求，明年產能將提升至3億美元，並持續透過加班及加速將北加州產能調度至南加州，以填補訂單缺口，預期產能滿載、供不應求的情況要到明年下半年才會舒緩。因應長期需求，研華也規畫在南加州進一步購地，擴充生產基地。
在地製造方面，牛文中表示，北美製造可滿足客戶在地化、供應鏈韌性及縮短交期需求，隨邊緣AI成長，加上在地服務、法遵及美國政策法規，帶動在地製造需求。透過在地研發、製造及交付，研華可提供深度客製化與在地支援，尤其軍工、金融等高機密性產業對美國製造需求較高。
研華北美南加州新總部坐落於加州Tustin ATEP園區，占地10英畝，總樓地板面積18.9萬平方英尺，總部大樓樓高6層，整體投資金額超過1億美元，園區涵蓋辦公室、組裝製造中心、倉儲、展示中心(Demo Room)及會議中心，新總部定位為商業與營運核心。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395‑TW) North America regional manager Niu Wen‑zhong said on the 23rd that Advantech’s overall BB Ratio for the first eight months is about 1.4, but it reaches 2.15 in North America and is expected to stay around 2 through year‑end. Because demand is strong, the North American plants are running at full capacity and supply cannot meet demand, and this capacity crunch is expected to last until the second half of next year.

Niu explained that North American customers’ requirements now extend to future development roadmaps, and the company has already planned ahead for the next two years. Consequently, the Design‑Win project volume in North America in the first half of this year already surpassed the full‑year $400 million of last year, and the second half is expected to be flat or even higher. The total Design‑Win volume for the year could be more than double last year’s, continuously feeding future performance.

Advantech currently operates three major production and operations sites in the United States: Ottawa, Illinois; Milpitas in Northern California; and the newly completed Tustin site in Southern California. Milpitas, formerly the main production hub, is now over‑capacity, while Tustin has already brought some production lines online to gradually share the project order load, with the operations headquarters slated to officially open in late October.

Niu added that Tustin is expected to reach a production capacity of $100 million this year, which is still insufficient for demand. Capacity will be raised to $300 million next year, and the company will continue to use overtime and accelerate the shift of Northern California capacity to Southern California to fill the order gap. The situation of full capacity and supply shortage is not expected to ease until the second half of next year. To meet long‑term demand, Advantech also plans to purchase additional land in Southern California to expand the plant.

Regarding local manufacturing, Niu said that North American production can satisfy customers’ needs for localization, supply‑chain resilience and shorter lead times. With the growth of edge AI, together with local services, regulatory compliance and U.S. policy requirements, demand for domestic manufacturing is being driven. Through local R&D, manufacturing and delivery, Advantech can provide deep customization and on‑site support, especially for high‑confidentiality sectors such as defense and finance that have strong demand for U.S.‑made products.

Advantech’s new North America headquarters in Southern California is located in the ATEP campus in Tustin, California, covering 10 acres with a total floor area of 189,000 square feet across six stories. The overall investment exceeds $100 million. The campus includes offices, an assembly‑manufacturing center, warehousing, a demo room and a conference center, positioning the new headquarters as the core of its commercial and operational activities.

items.title: 散戶大軍回神！8月證券劃撥存款餘額飆破4.5兆元 創歷史新高
items.title_en: Retail Investors Rally! August Securities Transfer Deposit Balance Surges Past NT$4.5 Trillion, Hitting a Historic High
paras: 台灣央行今(23)日公布7月國內金融情況，一向被視為「散戶風向球」的證券劃撥存款餘額較上月飆增3889億元至4兆5712億元，創歷史新高，單月增加3889億元也創史上最大增額，同時，8月台股融資餘額增至7589億元，創單月次高，僅次於6月。
央行說明，證券劃撥存款餘額「處於蠻高水準」，反映投資人信心升溫，散戶8月在台股的成交占比從上月的48.9%回升至50.9%，而本國法人由12%降至 10.2%，僑外法人降至38.8%。
此外，由於AI相關電子出口相當暢旺，廠商收取貨款，使8月外匯存款期底餘額升至9兆6488億元，較上月續增566億元，並續創歷史新高。
另一方面，央行8月日平均貨幣總計數M1B和M2年增率分別下降為6.65%、6.79%，其中，M2年增率下降主要因外匯存款及活期儲蓄存款成長減緩；累計前8月平均M1B及M2年增率分別為7.71%、6.62%。
央行進一步提到，8月全體貨幣機構放款與投資期底餘額共57.4兆元，年增9.43%，創27年半來最大增幅，主要AI強勁需求下，製造業購地、建廠、購料等資金需求增加。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan released July domestic financial data today (23rd), showing that the securities transfer deposit balance—often seen as the "retail investor barometer"—jumped by NT$388.9 billion from the previous month to NT$4,571.2 billion, a historic peak. The monthly increase of NT$388.9 billion also marks the largest rise ever recorded, while August margin financing balances rose to NT$758.9 billion, the second‑largest monthly total after June.

The bank explained that the securities transfer deposit balance is "at a fairly high level," reflecting warming investor confidence. Retail investors' share of Taiwan‑stock trading rose from 48.9% in the prior month to 50.9% in August, while domestic institutional investors fell from 12% to 10.2% and foreign institutional investors dropped to 38.8%.

In addition, strong exports of AI‑related electronics boosted manufacturers' cash receipts, pushing the end‑of‑month foreign‑exchange deposit balance up to NT$9,648.8 billion in August, an increase of NT$56.6 billion from the previous month and a new historical high.

On the other hand, the central bank reported that the average daily M1B and M2 growth rates for August fell to 6.65% and 6.79% year‑over‑year, respectively. The slowdown in M2 growth was mainly due to a deceleration in foreign‑exchange deposits and demand‑deposit growth; the cumulative average growth rates for the first eight months were 7.71% for M1B and 6.62% for M2.

The bank further noted that total loans and investment balances across all monetary institutions reached NT$57.4 trillion at the end of August, a 9.43% year‑over‑year increase—the largest rise in 27½ years—driven by strong AI demand that spurred manufacturing firms to spend on land acquisition, plant construction, and material purchases.

items.title: 台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Valuation Hits $5.3 Trillion, Overtakes India to Rank 4th Globally; TSMC Contributes Over NT$1 Trillion in One Day
paras: 台股今(23)日開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。
根據國際財經數據網站《MarketCapWatch》截至今日下午 5 時的最新統計，台灣股市總市值達到約 5.3 兆美元，正式超越印度的 4.94 兆美元，榮登全球第 4 大股票市場。目前全球前三大股市分別為美國 82.7 兆美元、中國 21.22 兆美元及日本 8.59 兆美元。
全球第 6 至 10 名的資本市場，依序為英國 4.86 兆美元、韓國 4.5 兆美元、加拿大 4.45 兆美元、法國 3.08 兆美元以及德國 3 兆美元。台股不僅展現強勁的本土資金動能，在全球資本市場的戰略地位亦大幅提升。
台股這波市值暴衝的核心引擎即為權王台積電(2330-TW)，今日股價收在 2,500 元、大漲 40 元，市值衝高至 64.83 兆元，單日狂增約 1 兆元，不但為台股創高奠定基石，台積美元計算的市值2.05兆美元，也在《MarketCapWatch》全球個股市值中排名第7名。與排名第6的SpaceX(SPCX-US)市值2.08兆美元相去不遠。
在半導體與 AI 供應鏈族群拉抬下，上市前二十大個股排名也出現顯著變化，ABF 載板廠欣興(3037-TW)上漲 40 元收在 1,160 元，市值激增 655 億元，站上 1.9 兆元，並成功攀升至第 9 名，將南亞(1303-TW)擠至第 10 名。
散熱龍頭奇鋐(3017-TW)市值上揚314億元、來到 1.36 兆元，名次超越中信金(2891-TW)前進至第 15 名；被動元件大廠國巨*(2327-TW)市值小幅回升，超越緯穎(6669-TW)名列第 18 名。
傳產、金融族群今天普遍面臨回檔，南亞(1303-TW)市值縮水 317 億元；高價股川湖(2059-TW)大跌 280 元收在 12,390 元，市值下修至 1.18 兆元，為上市前二十大中跌幅最深個股。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened higher today (23rd) and, despite trading in a high‑range oscillation, ended up up 357.12 points, closing at 48,157.29 points, again setting a fresh all‑time high. Taiwan’s capital market achieved a historic breakthrough, with total market cap soaring to about $5.3 trillion, surpassing India for the first time and moving into the world’s fourth‑largest stock market. The biggest contributor was the “national guardian” TSMC, which alone added more than NT$1 trillion to market value in a single day.

According to the international finance data site MarketCapWatch, the latest figures as of 5 p.m. today show Taiwan’s total stock market value at roughly $5.3 trillion, officially overtaking India’s $4.94 trillion and claiming the fourth‑largest spot globally. The top three markets remain the United States at $82.7 trillion, China at $21.22 trillion and Japan at $8.59 trillion.

The world’s sixth‑through‑tenth‑largest capital markets are, in order, the United Kingdom ($4.86 trillion), South Korea ($4.5 trillion), Canada ($4.45 trillion), France ($3.08 trillion) and Germany ($3 trillion). Taiwan’s market not only shows strong domestic capital momentum but also markedly improves its strategic standing in the global capital arena.

The engine behind this market‑cap surge is the heavyweight TSMC (2330‑TW). Its share price closed at NT$2,500, up NT$40, pushing its market cap to NT$64.83 trillion – an increase of about NT$1 trillion in a single day. This not only laid the foundation for the market’s new high, but TSMC’s dollar‑denominated market cap of $2.05 trillion ranks it seventh worldwide on MarketCapWatch, close behind the sixth‑ranked SpaceX (SPCX‑US) at $2.08 trillion.

Riding the semiconductor and AI supply‑chain rally, the top‑20 listed stocks saw notable reshuffling. PCB maker Xinte (3037‑TW) rose NT$40 to close at NT$1,160, boosting its market cap by NT$65.5 billion to NT$1.9 trillion and climbing to the ninth spot, pushing Nanya (1303‑TW) down to tenth place.

Thermal‑solution leader Qihong (3017‑TW) saw its market cap rise NT$31.4 billion to NT$1.36 trillion, overtaking CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) to move up to the 15th position. Passive‑component giant Yageo (2327‑TW) saw a modest market‑cap rebound, surpassing Weiying (6669‑TW) to rank 18th.

Traditional industry and financial stocks generally faced pull‑backs today. Nanya’s market cap shrank by NT$31.7 billion; high‑price stock Chuanhu (2059‑TW) plunged NT$280 to close at NT$12,390, reducing its market cap to NT$1.18 trillion, making it the steepest‑declining stock among the pre‑listing top‑20.

items.title: 中華電信積極投入6G前瞻技術 林榮賜：6G將朝向AI原生網路發展
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom Actively Invests in Forward‑Looking 6G Technology; Lin Rong‑tsai: 6G Will Evolve Toward AI‑Native Networks
paras: 中華電信(2412-TW)與6G產業論壇(6GIF)及台灣資通產業標準協會(TAICS)於今(23)日舉辦2026 6G Summit Taipei國際高峰會。中華電信積極投入5G-Advanced及6G前瞻技術，總經理林榮賜也指出，6G將進一步朝向AI原生(AI-Native)網路發展。
林榮賜表示，6G的突破不在於單一硬體或軟體技術，而是在於打造跨產業協作的次世代數位生態系。相較於5G著重高速率、低延遲及大規模物聯網，6G將朝向AI原生網路發展。
林榮賜進一步指出，AI從應用層走向通訊基礎設施，並結合AI-RAN、整合感測與通訊(ISAC)、非地面網路(NTN)及低空經濟等創新技術，將數位連結從地面延伸至空中，開啟萬物智慧聯網的新時代。他認為，台灣因有頂尖的半導體實力及完整的ICT產業鏈，有望成為全球6G創新的合作夥伴。
因此中華電信長期積極投入5G-Advanced及6G前瞻技術，持續參與3GPP國際標準組織與NGMN等國際產業聯盟，並投入相關技術標準制定工作，與全球電信業者、設備商及研究機構交流合作，共同推動掌握前瞻網路技術與產業趨勢。
中華電信也於2026 6G Summit Taipei國際高峰會中，展出「多軌衛星通訊服務」，整合高軌、中軌、低軌衛星及衛星通話等通訊能力，並與既有地面網路協同運作，提供完整多軌衛星通訊解決方案。透過不同軌道衛星在涵蓋範圍、傳輸能力及應用情境上互補，逐步建構涵蓋「海、地、星、空」多層次的通訊備援架構。
中華電信表示，面對未來6G天地融合及AI原生網路發展趨勢，將持續深化國際合作，投入標準制定與關鍵技術研發，並配合台灣未來6G頻譜規劃與釋出時程，推動新世代通訊技術落地應用。
paras_en: Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) together with the 6G Industry Forum (6GIF) and the Taiwan ICT Industry Standards Association (TAICS) held the 2026 6G Summit Taipei international summit today (the 23rd). Chunghwa Telecom is actively investing in 5G‑Advanced and forward‑looking 6G technologies, and its general manager Lin Rong‑tsai noted that 6G will further develop toward AI‑native networks.

Lin said that the breakthrough of 6G does not lie in any single hardware or software technology, but in building a next‑generation digital ecosystem through cross‑industry collaboration. Compared with 5G, which focuses on high speed, low latency and massive IoT, 6G will move toward AI‑native networking.

Lin further explained that AI will shift from the application layer to the communications infrastructure, integrating AI‑RAN, integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), non‑terrestrial networks (NTN) and the low‑altitude economy, extending digital connectivity from the ground to the sky and ushering in a new era of intelligent networking for everything. He believes Taiwan, with its world‑class semiconductor strength and complete ICT supply chain, is poised to become a global partner for 6G innovation.

Accordingly, Chunghwa Telecom has long been actively investing in 5G‑Advanced and forward‑looking 6G technologies, continuously participating in the 3GPP international standards body and industry alliances such as NGMN, contributing to related standards work, and collaborating with global operators, equipment vendors and research institutions to jointly drive the adoption of cutting‑edge network technologies and industry trends.

At the 2026 6G Summit Taipei, Chunghwa Telecom also showcased a “multi‑orbit satellite communication service,” integrating high‑, medium‑ and low‑orbit satellites as well as satellite voice capabilities, working in tandem with existing terrestrial networks to provide a complete multi‑orbit satellite communication solution. By leveraging the complementary coverage, capacity and use‑case strengths of different orbital satellites, it is gradually building a multi‑layer communication redundancy architecture spanning sea, land, space and air.

Chunghwa Telecom said that in response to the future convergence of 6G terrestrial‑satellite networks and AI‑native networking, it will continue to deepen international cooperation, invest in standards development and key technology R&D, and align with Taiwan’s upcoming 6G spectrum planning and release schedule to bring next‑generation communications technologies to market.

items.title: 成交！潤泰新持有南港「潤泰玉成廣場」全棟以202.18億元賣給凱基人壽
items.title_en: Deal! Runtaixin sells its entire Nangang "Runtaix Yu Cheng Plaza" for NT$20.218 billion to KGI Life Insurance
paras: 潤泰新(9945-TW)今(23)日公告，旗下潤泰創新國際持有的台北市南港商辦「潤泰玉成廣場」，以202.18億元售出，買家是「凱基人壽保險公司」，創下全台單一商辦大樓成交金額最高紀錄。
潤泰新今天公告，代子公司潤泰創新開發公司處分「潤泰南港玉成廣場」，交易金額達202.18億元，出售給為凱基人壽保險。估計處分利益達99.19億元，包括售後租回。
台北市南港「潤泰南港玉成廣場」，目前是全球AI龍頭NVIDIA輝達在台的研發中心。。
輝達於2023年12月底，租下「潤泰南港玉成廣場」3-17樓共15個樓層，承租面積達1萬259.31坪，承租期達10年1個月，累計總租金達28.97億元。
paras_en: Runtaixin (9945‑TW) announced today (the 23rd) that its subsidiary Runtaix Innovation International’s Taipei City Nangang office‑commercial building “Runtaix Yu Cheng Plaza” was sold for NT$20.218 billion to KGI Life Insurance, setting a record for the highest transaction price for a single office building in Taiwan.

Runtaixin announced today that, on behalf of its subsidiary Runtaix Innovation Development Company, it disposed of “Runtaix Nangang Yu Cheng Plaza” for NT$20.218 billion, selling to KGI Life Insurance. The estimated disposal profit is NT$9.919 billion, including a sale‑and‑leaseback arrangement.
The Taipei Nangang “Runtaix Nangang Yu Cheng Plaza” currently hosts the Taiwan research and development centre of global AI leader NVIDIA.

At the end of December 2023, NVIDIA leased floors 3‑17 of the “Runtaix Nangang Yu Cheng Plaza” – a total of 15 floors covering 12,593.31 ping – for a term of 10 years and 1 month, with cumulative rent amounting to NT$2.897 billion.

items.title: 輝達加速東南亞主權AI落地 擴大導入政府與智慧城市
items.title_en: NVIDIA Accelerates Sovereign AI Deployment in Southeast Asia, Expanding Government and Smart City Adoption
paras: AI逐步成為各國國家戰略的重要一環，隨著各國政府積極將AI從試點階段推向實際部署，如何建立符合在地語言、文化、政策優先順序與經濟需求的AI能力，成為發展重點。輝達(NVDA-US)今(23)日表示，正透過技術、基礎設施、生態系與專業能力，協助東南亞各國推進AI國家布局。
為加速東南亞AI轉型，NVIDIA正藉由開放模型、開發者工具及合作夥伴生態系，協助各國將AI由實驗階段導入生產級應用，並聚焦政府營運與公共服務、AI驅動民眾服務及企業應用、關鍵基礎設施與公共安全，以及新創、開發者與研究能量等四大領域。
在新加坡，新加坡內政科技局(HTX)正運用NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super及Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型進行研究，推動AI在公共安全領域的應用。其中，Nemotron 3 Super可望支援複雜推理與代理型工作流程，Nemotron 3 Nano Omni則整合視覺、音訊與語言能力，可用於開發以真實世界營運資料為基礎的多模態應用。
NVIDIA指出，兩款模型搭配使用，可進一步強化HTX在新加坡內政團隊部署安全、且由在地自主掌控AI的能力。
企業端方面，恩士迅(NCS)正導入Nemotron模型與NVIDIA VSS Blueprint，加速企業與公部門採用代理型AI，同時推動物理AI應用於人形機器人，以因應安全性、即時回應及資料治理需求。
ST Engineering則利用NVIDIA NeMo工具與NVIDIA cuOpt軟體開發AI Studio平台，並將代理型AI解決方案導入旗下業務，包括船舶維修、翻修與大修（Marine MRO）等應用場景。
相關AI布局也逐步擴展至東南亞其他市場。馬來西亞YTL AI Labs正針對企業與公民服務微調Nemotron模型，Viettel AI則針對越南語應用進行模型微調。
泰國方面，參與泰國大型語言模型專案（ThaiLLM）的Big Data Institute與iApp Technology，正探索以Nemotron作為基礎模型。其中，iApp Technology初期鎖定法律應用，透過NVIDIA NeMo框架，以泰語法律資料微調OpenThai 2.0 Legal，進一步調整Nemotron 3 Nano。
該模型目前以開源形式提供給泰國開發者社群，並作為iApp Technology旗下法律助理聊天機器人Thanoy的核心模型，目前已服務約4.3萬名使用者。
在汶萊，Antrique則建置AI創新平台，協助提升當地食品產業生產力。
除生成式與代理型AI外，NVIDIA也將相關技術延伸至智慧城市應用。NVIDIA Cosmos開放世界模型與NVIDIA VSS Blueprint目前正於東南亞推動智慧城市解決方案，馬來西亞ITMAX結合Cosmos與VSS改善城市交通營運，泰國AS-TECH則採用相同技術架構，改善機場旅客動線。
NVIDIA表示，將持續透過模型、工具與合作夥伴生態系，推動東南亞各國AI應用從實驗階段邁向實際部署。
paras_en: AI is increasingly becoming a key component of national strategies worldwide. As governments push AI from pilot stages to real-world deployment, the focus is on building capabilities that align with local languages, cultures, policy priorities, and economic needs. NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced today that it is helping Southeast Asian countries advance their AI national plans through technology, infrastructure, ecosystem, and expertise.

To accelerate AI transformation in Southeast Asia, NVIDIA is leveraging open models, developer tools, and partner ecosystems to help countries move AI from experimental to production-level applications. The company is focusing on four key areas: government operations and public services, AI-driven citizen services and enterprise applications, critical infrastructure and public safety, and innovation, developer, and research ecosystems.

In Singapore, the Home Affairs Technology (HTX) agency is using NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni models for research, driving AI applications in public safety. Nemotron 3 Super is expected to support complex reasoning and agent-based workflows, while Nemotron 3 Nano Omni integrates vision, audio, and language capabilities for multimodal applications built on real-world operational data.
NVIDIA notes that using the two models together can further strengthen HTX’s Singapore Home Affairs team’s ability to deploy secure, locally controlled AI.

On the corporate side, NCS is adopting Nemotron models and NVIDIA VSS Blueprint to accelerate enterprise and public sector adoption of agent-based AI, while also advancing physical AI applications in humanoid robots to meet safety, real-time response, and data governance needs.

ST Engineering is using NVIDIA NeMo tools and NVIDIA cuOpt software to develop an AI Studio platform, and is deploying agent-based AI solutions across its businesses, including marine MRO (maintenance, repair, and overhaul) applications.

AI initiatives are also expanding to other Southeast Asian markets. YTL AI Labs in Malaysia is fine-tuning Nemotron models for enterprise and citizen services, while Viettel AI is fine-tuning models for Vietnamese language applications.

In Thailand, the Big Data Institute and iApp Technology, participants in the ThaiLLM large language model project, are exploring Nemotron as a base model. iApp Technology initially focused on legal applications, fine-tuning OpenThai 2.0 Legal with the NVIDIA NeMo framework and further adjusting Nemotron 3 Nano for Thai legal data.

The model is currently available in open source to the Thai developer community and serves as the core model for iApp Technology’s legal assistant chatbot Thanoy, which already serves about 43,000 users.
In Brunei, Antrique has built an AI innovation platform to boost local food industry productivity.

Beyond generative and agent-based AI, NVIDIA is extending its technology to smart city applications. NVIDIA Cosmos open-world models and NVIDIA VSS Blueprint are currently being promoted in Southeast Asia for smart city solutions. Malaysia’s ITMAX combines Cosmos and VSS to improve urban traffic operations, while Thailand’s AS-TECH uses the same technology stack to enhance airport passenger flow.
NVIDIA says it will continue to drive Southeast Asian countries’ AI applications from experimental to real deployment through models, tools, and partner ecosystems.

items.title: imec IC-Link擴大與台積電合作 支援夥伴混合式EDA
items.title_en: imec IC‑Link Expands Collaboration with TSMC to Support Partners' Hybrid EDA
paras: 比利時微電子研究中心(imec)旗下IC-Link今(23)日攜手台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)宣布，拓展雙方合作，以便客戶獲取先進製程節點的半導體設計能力。IC-Link作為台積電開放創新平台(OIP)雲端聯盟的最新成員，將率先成為首位提供由雲端管理的晶片設計服務商，支援多方夥伴的混合式EDA流程。
IC-Link為imec旗下特定應用積體電路(ASIC)與矽光子晶片製造與設計服務團隊，先前已加入台積電OIP聯盟，此次透過雲端服務，結合先進製程節點的技術取用性、基於安全雲端環境的設計能力與專家支援，以協助創新人才加速晶片設計概念的落地。
imec指出，半導體元件的開發越來越複雜，設計團隊面臨更嚴苛的要求，包含運算資源、設計基礎設施、技術與工具的安全使用管道，以及產品上市時程，透過結合台積電領先業界的製程技術與生態系統，以及imec IC-Link的設計賦能專業，可望協助客戶在為AI、通訊、汽車、工業等高速成長的應用開發先進晶片時，降低設計複雜度。
運用IC-Link提供的安全雲端環境，客戶能在可控環境中獲取台積電的製程設計套件(PDK)，同時取得可針對特定晶片開發工作負載而彈性擴展的運算資源優勢。該平台支援彈性的EDA設計流程，有助於客戶使用各自偏好的工具鏈與技術授權，而IC-Link提供安全的代管服務、基礎設施管理，以及所需的設計資源使用權。藉此，設計團隊就能專注創新與產品開發，而無須建立或維持複雜的設計環境。
這項合作計畫基於imec與台積電的長期合作，包含IC-Link近期參與台積電開放創新平台的3DFabric聯盟，以及進一步拓展IC-Link服務範圍，以開放需要先進半導體技術的客戶使用。此外，IC-Link早在2009年即加入台積電價值鏈聚合聯盟(VCA)，並於2007年成為其設計中心聯盟(DCA)成員。
獲取先進製程節點的設計能力一直是眾多新興半導體業者和研究團隊的關鍵需求。此次擴大合作鞏固了IC-Link在串聯半導體創新與製造方面所扮演的可靠橋接角色，並為促進歐洲等地的半導體創新注入更多動能。

Imec IC-Link 的ASIC服務部門副總 Pierre Blondeau表示，隨著晶片設計的複雜度增加，創新人員必須採取全方位的解決方案，涵蓋先進技術、雲端基礎設施、設計專業與技術支援，以高效率推動晶片設計落地。透過加入台積電開放創新平台的雲端聯盟，公司現在結合獲取台積電先進節點技術的使用管道，以及基於安全雲端環境與多方夥伴混合式EDA流程的設計能力與專家支援，進一步推廣先進半導體的創新。目前我們正攜手台積電，共同協助客戶降低複雜度、加速開發週期，並更確信推動設計概念邁向終端市場的商品化。
台積電生態系統與聯盟管理部門主管Aveek Sarkar表示，台積電的開放創新平台生態系統以建立合作為基礎，推動實現半導體業的創新。很榮幸能夠拓展與imec旗下IC-Link晶片製造與設計服務團隊的合作，並協助更廣泛的創新社群獲取先進的製程與封裝設計能力。透過與IC-Link等開放創新平台夥伴合作，希望能協助客戶加速推出創新晶片，同時發揮現代設計環境在彈性、可擴充性與安全性方面的優勢。
paras_en: Belgian microelectronics research centre imec’s IC‑Link announced today, together with TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US), an expansion of their cooperation so that customers can access semiconductor design capabilities on advanced process nodes. As the newest member of TSMC’s Open Innovation Platform (OIP) cloud alliance, IC‑Link will be the first cloud‑managed chip design service provider, supporting multiple partners in hybrid EDA workflows.

IC‑Link, imec’s dedicated ASIC and silicon‑photonic chip manufacturing and design services team, had already joined TSMC’s OIP alliance. This time, through cloud services that combine access to advanced process‑node technology, secure cloud‑based design capabilities and expert support, it aims to help innovators accelerate the realization of chip design concepts.

imec notes that semiconductor component development is becoming increasingly complex, with design teams facing stricter demands for compute resources, design infrastructure, secure use of technologies and tools, and product time‑to‑market. By combining TSMC’s industry‑leading process technology and ecosystem with imec IC‑Link’s design‑enablement expertise, customers developing advanced chips for fast‑growing AI, communications, automotive, industrial and other applications can reduce design complexity.

Using the secure cloud environment provided by IC‑Link, customers can obtain TSMC’s process design kits (PDKs) in a controlled setting while also gaining flexible, scalable compute resources tailored to specific chip‑development workloads. The platform supports flexible EDA design flows, allowing customers to use their preferred toolchains and technology licenses, while IC‑Link delivers secure managed services, infrastructure management, and the necessary design‑resource rights. This lets design teams focus on innovation and product development without having to build or maintain complex design environments.

The collaboration builds on imec’s long‑term partnership with TSMC, including IC‑Link’s recent participation in TSMC’s OIP 3DFabric alliance and the further expansion of IC‑Link’s services to open advanced semiconductor technology to customers. IC‑Link has been part of TSMC’s Value‑Chain Aggregation alliance (VCA) since 2009 and joined its Design Center Alliance (DCA) in 2007.

Access to design capabilities on advanced process nodes has long been a critical need for many emerging semiconductor companies and research teams. This expanded cooperation reinforces IC‑Link’s reliable bridging role between semiconductor innovation and manufacturing, injecting additional momentum into semiconductor innovation in Europe and elsewhere.

Pierre Blondeau, Vice‑President of the ASIC Services division at imec IC‑Link, said that as chip design complexity grows, innovators must adopt end‑to‑end solutions covering advanced technology, cloud infrastructure, design expertise and technical support to efficiently bring designs to fruition. By joining TSMC’s OIP cloud alliance, the company now combines access to TSMC’s advanced‑node technology with secure cloud‑based, multi‑partner hybrid EDA capabilities and expert support, further promoting advanced semiconductor innovation. He added that together with TSMC they are helping customers lower complexity, accelerate development cycles, and confidently move design concepts toward market‑ready products.

Aveek Sarkar, Head of TSMC’s Ecosystem and Alliance Management, said the OIP ecosystem is built on collaboration to drive semiconductor industry innovation. He expressed pride in expanding cooperation with imec’s IC‑Link chip manufacturing and design services team and in enabling a broader innovation community to access advanced process and packaging design capabilities. By working with OIP partners such as IC‑Link, TSMC aims to help customers launch innovative chips faster while leveraging the flexibility, scalability and security of modern design environments.

items.title: 輝達加速東南亞主權AI落地 擴大導入政府與智慧城市
items.title_en: NVIDIA Accelerates Sovereign AI Deployment in Southeast Asia, Expanding Government and Smart City Adoption
paras: AI逐步成為各國國家戰略的重要一環，隨著各國政府積極將AI從試點階段推向實際部署，如何建立符合在地語言、文化、政策優先順序與經濟需求的AI能力，成為發展重點。輝達(NVDA-US)今(23)日表示，正透過技術、基礎設施、生態系與專業能力，協助東南亞各國推進AI國家布局。
為加速東南亞AI轉型，NVIDIA正藉由開放模型、開發者工具及合作夥伴生態系，協助各國將AI由實驗階段導入生產級應用，並聚焦政府營運與公共服務、AI驅動民眾服務及企業應用、關鍵基礎設施與公共安全，以及新創、開發者與研究能量等四大領域。
在新加坡，新加坡內政科技局(HTX)正運用NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super及Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型進行研究，推動AI在公共安全領域的應用。其中，Nemotron 3 Super可望支援複雜推理與代理型工作流程，Nemotron 3 Nano Omni則整合視覺、音訊與語言能力，可用於開發以真實世界營運資料為基礎的多模態應用。
NVIDIA指出，兩款模型搭配使用，可進一步強化HTX在新加坡內政團隊部署安全、且由在地自主掌控AI的能力。
企業端方面，恩士迅(NCS)正導入Nemotron模型與NVIDIA VSS Blueprint，加速企業與公部門採用代理型AI，同時推動物理AI應用於人形機器人，以因應安全性、即時回應及資料治理需求。
ST Engineering則利用NVIDIA NeMo工具與NVIDIA cuOpt軟體開發AI Studio平台，並將代理型AI解決方案導入旗下業務，包括船舶維修、翻修與大修（Marine MRO）等應用場景。
相關AI布局也逐步擴展至東南亞其他市場。馬來西亞YTL AI Labs正針對企業與公民服務微調Nemotron模型，Viettel AI則針對越南語應用進行模型微調。
泰國方面，參與泰國大型語言模型專案（ThaiLLM）的Big Data Institute與iApp Technology，正探索以Nemotron作為基礎模型。其中，iApp Technology初期鎖定法律應用，透過NVIDIA NeMo框架，以泰語法律資料微調OpenThai 2.0 Legal，進一步調整Nemotron 3 Nano。
該模型目前以開源形式提供給泰國開發者社群，並作為iApp Technology旗下法律助理聊天機器人Thanoy的核心模型，目前已服務約4.3萬名使用者。
在汶萊，Antrique則建置AI創新平台，協助提升當地食品產業生產力。
除生成式與代理型AI外，NVIDIA也將相關技術延伸至智慧城市應用。NVIDIA Cosmos開放世界模型與NVIDIA VSS Blueprint目前正於東南亞推動智慧城市解決方案，馬來西亞ITMAX結合Cosmos與VSS改善城市交通營運，泰國AS-TECH則採用相同技術架構，改善機場旅客動線。
NVIDIA表示，將持續透過模型、工具與合作夥伴生態系，推動東南亞各國AI應用從實驗階段邁向實際部署。
paras_en: AI is increasingly becoming a key component of national strategies worldwide. As governments push AI from pilot stages to real-world deployment, the focus is on building capabilities that align with local languages, cultures, policy priorities, and economic needs. NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced today that it is helping Southeast Asian countries advance their AI national plans through technology, infrastructure, ecosystem, and expertise.

To accelerate AI transformation in Southeast Asia, NVIDIA is leveraging open models, developer tools, and partner ecosystems to help countries move AI from experimental to production-level applications. The company is focusing on four key areas: government operations and public services, AI-driven citizen services and enterprise applications, critical infrastructure and public safety, and innovation, developer, and research ecosystems.

In Singapore, the Home Affairs Technology (HTX) agency is using NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni models for research, driving AI applications in public safety. Nemotron 3 Super is expected to support complex reasoning and agent-based workflows, while Nemotron 3 Nano Omni integrates vision, audio, and language capabilities for multimodal applications built on real-world operational data.
NVIDIA notes that using the two models together can further strengthen HTX’s Singapore Home Affairs team’s ability to deploy secure, locally controlled AI.

On the corporate side, NCS is adopting Nemotron models and NVIDIA VSS Blueprint to accelerate enterprise and public sector adoption of agent-based AI, while also advancing physical AI applications in humanoid robots to meet safety, real-time response, and data governance needs.

ST Engineering is using NVIDIA NeMo tools and NVIDIA cuOpt software to develop an AI Studio platform, and is deploying agent-based AI solutions across its businesses, including marine MRO (maintenance, repair, and overhaul) applications.

AI initiatives are also expanding to other Southeast Asian markets. YTL AI Labs in Malaysia is fine-tuning Nemotron models for enterprise and citizen services, while Viettel AI is fine-tuning models for Vietnamese language applications.

In Thailand, the Big Data Institute and iApp Technology, participants in the ThaiLLM large language model project, are exploring Nemotron as a base model. iApp Technology initially focused on legal applications, fine-tuning OpenThai 2.0 Legal with the NVIDIA NeMo framework and further adjusting Nemotron 3 Nano for Thai legal data.

The model is currently available in open source to the Thai developer community and serves as the core model for iApp Technology’s legal assistant chatbot Thanoy, which already serves about 43,000 users.
In Brunei, Antrique has built an AI innovation platform to boost local food industry productivity.

Beyond generative and agent-based AI, NVIDIA is extending its technology to smart city applications. NVIDIA Cosmos open-world models and NVIDIA VSS Blueprint are currently being promoted in Southeast Asia for smart city solutions. Malaysia’s ITMAX combines Cosmos and VSS to improve urban traffic operations, while Thailand’s AS-TECH uses the same technology stack to enhance airport passenger flow.
NVIDIA says it will continue to drive Southeast Asian countries’ AI applications from experimental to real deployment through models, tools, and partner ecosystems.

items.title: 巴克萊：美期中選舉季節性效應浮現 但這兩項風險影響更大
items.title_en: Barclays: Seasonal Midterm Election Effect Appears, but Two Risks Matter More
paras: 巴克萊(Barclays)表示，股票市場目前正遵循歷史期中選舉前夕的典型季節性規律，但選舉對政策與市場的實際影響預計相對有限，油價與利率才是決定未來股市走勢的更關鍵因素。
以Emmanuel Cau為首的巴克萊策略團隊表示，自夏季高點以來，MSCI世界指數已下跌約3%，這與歷年期中選舉前的平均修正幅度吻合。Cau的團隊指出，歷史經驗顯示無須過度悲觀，因為股市通常在10月中旬(甚至在投票日之前)就會開始反彈回升。
在政局情勢方面，巴克萊公共政策分析師分析，當前基準情境為「分裂政府」，即民主黨較有望贏得眾議院，參議院則勢均力敵，而共和黨全面勝選(橫掃兩院)的機率最低。
民調與預測市場顯示，民主黨在通用選票上領先8個百分點，且有約60%的機率贏得兩院控制權。策略團隊認為，無論最終結果如何，對股市的實質影響均屬溫和。儘管國會未來可能加強對科技、醫療保健與銀行業的監管，並引發短期新聞頭條波動，但不大會改變產業基本面。
策略團隊補充，財政政策在分裂國會下可能微幅放寬，而貿易政策大幅變動的可能性極低。相較之下，策略團隊強調「油價與利率握有股市的命運」。
高殖利率與高油價持續施壓川普總統的施政滿意度，股票對這兩大因素的敏感度已轉為負面，這將促使政府更有動力控制能源價格。
在投資策略上，Cau的團隊建議採取中性Beta(中度風險)立場，優先布局銀行股、價值股及資本支出受惠類股，並搭配電信與公用事業等防禦性類股進行避險。至於輪動回歐洲市場或消費類股等週期性落後標的，則需等待油價與利率進一步穩定。
paras_en: Barclays says the equity market is currently following the typical seasonal pattern seen before historic midterm elections, but the actual impact of the election on policy and markets is expected to be relatively limited; oil prices and interest rates are the more decisive factors for future stock market direction.

Led by Emmanuel Cau, Barclays’ strategy team notes that since the summer peak the MSCI World Index has fallen about 3%, matching the average correction seen before past midterm elections. Cau’s team points out that history shows there is no need for excessive pessimism, as markets usually start to rebound in mid‑October (often even before Election Day).

Regarding the political landscape, Barclays public‑policy analysts see the baseline scenario as a ‘divided government’, with Democrats more likely to win the House, the Senate a toss‑up, and a full Republican sweep of both chambers the least likely outcome.

Polls and market forecasts show Democrats leading the generic ballot by eight points and having roughly a 60% chance of controlling both chambers. The strategy team believes that regardless of the final result, the substantive impact on equities will be modest. Even if Congress later tightens oversight of technology, healthcare and banking, causing short‑term headline volatility, the underlying industry fundamentals are unlikely to change.

The team adds that fiscal policy under a divided Congress may be slightly more accommodative, while the odds of a major shift in trade policy are very low. By contrast, they stress that “oil prices and interest rates hold the fate of the stock market.”

High yields and elevated oil prices continue to pressure President Trump’s approval ratings, making stocks increasingly sensitive to these two factors in a negative way, which should give the government more incentive to rein in energy prices.

For investment positioning, Cau’s team recommends a neutral‑beta (moderate‑risk) stance, favoring banks, value stocks and capital‑expenditure beneficiaries, while hedging with defensive sectors such as telecoms and utilities. Rotation into European markets or consumer‑cyclicals should wait until oil prices and rates stabilize.

items.title: AI撐起2026全球經濟！OECD警告能源衝擊恐拖累2027並推升通膨 美歐日等央行恐需進一步升息
items.title_en: AI Boosts the 2026 Global Economy! OECD Warns Energy Shock Could Drag Down 2027 Growth and Raise Inflation, Prompting Further Rate Hikes by Central Banks in the US, Europe, Japan and Others
paras: 經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)周三(23日)上修今年全球經濟成長預測至2.9%，主要歸功於人工智慧(AI)帶動的投資，但也表示，由於中東衝突引發的能源與大宗商品價格衝擊，2027年全球成長預測從3.1%降到3%。而且鑒於全球通膨將高於先前預期，從美國到澳洲等央行可能都需要進一步收緊貨幣政策。
總部位於巴黎的OECD在最新發布的臨時經濟展望中預估，2026年全球經濟成長率將為2.9%，略優於6月預估的2.8%。去年全球經濟成長3.4%。
展望2027年，中東衝突引發的大宗商品價格衝擊預料將拖累經濟動能，OECD預估全球經濟成長率僅回升至3.0%，低於6月預估的3.1%。
OECD表示，從資料中心到半導體的AI基礎設施支出強勁，是今年全球經濟展現韌性的關鍵支柱之一，這不僅推動美國經濟成長，也帶動日本與南韓科技出口。

能源衝擊升溫 OECD上修全球通膨預測

不過，OECD警告，全球經濟展望尤其受到能源市場動盪風險、強勁聖嬰現象(El Niño)引發的極端天氣、政府公債殖利率飆升，以及AI投資報酬令人失望等因素籠罩。
OECD估算，如果上述風險同時成真，明年全球經濟成長可能合計減少0.7個百分點，全球通膨率則可能提高1.1個百分點。
在OECD的基準展望中，G20經濟體2026年通膨率預估為4.1%，高於6月預估的4.0%，2027年預估值也從6月的3.1%上修至3.6%。
OECD表示，如果價格壓力擴大，或經濟成長失速，通膨升溫可能迫使各國央行調整利率政策。
OECD在報告中表示：「面對能源價格再度受到衝擊，以及需求壓力強於預期之際，加上許多經濟體的通膨率已高於目標，央行需要確保潛在通膨壓力得到持久控制。」
OECD的評估出爐之際，全球央行本月已掀起一波緊縮行動，美國聯準會(Fed)、歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BOJ)均在短短一周多的時間內升息。
OECD官員認為，未來還會有更多類似行動，但也表示，這波升息規模不會達到2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後各國採取的激進貨幣政策緊縮程度。
OECD預測，Fed今年還會升息一次，此外，歐元區、澳洲與南韓則會「進一步溫和升息」，日本則會「進一步升息」。相較之下，OECD表示，英國央行(BOE)與加拿大央行(BOC)目前將維持利率不變。

市場對升息次數看法分歧

這與投資人的看法略有不同。目前貨幣市場對Fed、ECB與BOE今年底前會再升息一次還是兩次，幾乎各半。
不過，交易員較確定日本今年底前只會再升息1次，同時也傾向認為加拿大將在這段期間升息1碼。
OECD表示，全球經濟成長路徑與6月相比大致沒有變化。相較於其他幅度有限的預測調整，加拿大與法國的展望下修較為突出。加拿大正面臨與美國的貿易戰，法國則面臨一段政治不穩定時期。
OECD表示：「全球經濟展望仍高度取決於中東衝突能否達成持久解決方案。貿易政策持續變動，包括關稅與出口限制，增加政策不確定性，並導致供應中斷。」

美中日歐展望分歧

在全球最大經濟體美國方面，OECD預估2026年經濟成長率為2.2%，2027年為2.1%，兩項預測均較6月上修。大量AI相關投資抵銷消費支出疲弱的影響，成為支撐美國經濟的主要力量。
美國2026年通膨率預估將達3.6%，2027年降至2.6%，關稅與能源價格上漲將壓縮家庭購買力，並推升企業成本。
中國經濟成長預估今年放緩至4.5%，2027年進一步降至4.2%，兩項預測均與6月相同。北京抑制過剩工業產能的措施將拖累投資，消費面臨通膨逐步上升帶來的壓力。
歐元區2026年與2027年經濟成長率均預估為1.0%。能源價格與利率走高將持續壓抑經濟活動，直到新增國防支出計畫開始提供支撐。
歐元區通膨率今年預估為3.0%，2027年為2.9%。天然氣價格上漲是推升通膨的部分原因，歐洲天然氣庫存水準在進入冬季供暖期前降至15年低點。
日本經濟預估2026年成長0.8%，2027年成長0.7%。升息與能源進口成本增加的影響，將抵銷強勁企業投資帶來的支撐。但與其他主要經濟體不同，日本通膨率預估將從今年的1.8%加速至2027年的2.6%，反映勞動市場緊俏與薪資強勁成長。
加拿大2026年經濟成長預測則從6月的1.2%下修至0.9%，2027年展望也從1.7%降至1.3%，主因美國對加拿大出口祭出新的關稅措施。
paras_en: The Organisation for Economic Co‑operation and Development (OECD) on Wednesday (the 23rd) raised its forecast for global economic growth this year to 2.9%, mainly thanks to investment driven by artificial intelligence (AI), but warned that the energy and commodity price shock triggered by the Middle‑East conflict would cut the 2027 global growth forecast from 3.1% to 3.0%. It also noted that, given global inflation is expected to be higher than previously thought, central banks from the United States to Australia may need to tighten monetary policy further.
Based in Paris, the OECD’s latest interim economic outlook estimates the global economy will grow at 2.9% in 2026, a shade above the 2.8% projected in June. Global growth was 3.4% last year.

Looking ahead to 2027, the commodity‑price shock stemming from the Middle‑East conflict is expected to dampen economic momentum, with the OECD forecasting global growth at only 3.0%, down from the 3.1% forecast made in June.

The OECD said that strong AI‑related infrastructure spending – from data centres to semiconductors – is one of the key pillars underpinning this year’s economic resilience, boosting growth in the United States and driving technology exports from Japan and South Korea.

Energy shock heats up: OECD lifts global inflation forecast. However, the OECD warned that the global outlook is especially clouded by risks from volatile energy markets, extreme weather linked to a strong El Niño, soaring sovereign‑bond yields and disappointing returns on AI investments.

The OECD estimates that if all of these risks materialise simultaneously, global growth could be reduced by a total of 0.7 percentage points next year and the global inflation rate could rise by 1.1 percentage points.
In the OECD’s baseline scenario, inflation in G20 economies is projected at 4.1% in 2026, up from the 4.0% forecast in June, and the 2027 estimate is revised from 3.1% to 3.6%.
The OECD said that if price pressures intensify or growth stalls, rising inflation could force central banks to adjust their rate policies.

The OECD report states: “Faced with renewed energy‑price shocks and demand pressures stronger than expected, coupled with many economies already seeing inflation above target, central banks need to ensure that underlying inflationary pressures remain under durable control.”

As the OECD’s assessment was released, central banks around the world have already launched a wave of tightening this month, with the US Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan all raising rates within just over a week.
OECD officials expect more such actions in the future, but say the current round of hikes will not reach the aggressive tightening seen after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

The OECD forecasts that the Fed will raise rates once more this year, while the euro‑area, Australia and South Korea will “further moderate” their hikes and Japan will “further raise” rates. By contrast, the OECD says the Bank of England and the Bank of Canada are likely to keep rates unchanged for now.

Market views on the number of rate hikes are split. This differs slightly from investors’ expectations, as money‑market participants are roughly evenly divided on whether the Fed, ECB and BOE will each deliver one or two more hikes before year‑end.
However, traders are more confident that Japan will only raise rates once more before year‑end and tend to think Canada will also deliver a single 25‑basis‑point hike in that period.

The OECD says the overall global growth path has not changed much since June. Compared with other modest forecast adjustments, the outlooks for Canada and France have been revised down more sharply. Canada faces a trade dispute with the United States, while France is dealing with a period of political instability.

The OECD adds: “The global economic outlook remains highly dependent on whether a lasting solution to the Middle‑East conflict can be achieved. Ongoing shifts in trade policy, including tariffs and export restrictions, increase policy uncertainty and cause supply disruptions.”

Diverging outlooks for the US, China, Japan and the euro area. For the United States, the OECD projects a 2.2% growth rate in 2026 and 2.1% in 2027, both revisions upward from June. Heavy AI‑related investment offsets weak consumer spending, becoming the main engine of US growth.
US inflation is forecast at 3.6% in 2026 and 2.6% in 2027, with tariffs and higher energy prices squeezing household purchasing power and pushing up corporate costs.

China’s growth forecast is slowed to 4.5% for this year and further to 4.2% in 2027, unchanged from June. Beijing’s measures to curb excess industrial capacity are expected to drag on investment, while consumption faces pressure from gradually rising inflation.

The euro area is projected to grow at 1.0% in both 2026 and 2027. Rising energy prices and higher interest rates will continue to suppress activity until new defence‑spending programmes begin to provide support.

Euro‑area inflation is forecast at 3.0% for this year and 2.9% in 2027. Higher natural‑gas prices are a key driver, with European gas inventories falling to a 15‑year low ahead of the winter heating season.

Japan’s economy is projected to grow 0.8% in 2026 and 0.7% in 2027. The impact of rate hikes and higher energy‑import costs will offset strong corporate investment, but unlike other major economies, Japan’s inflation is expected to accelerate from 1.8% this year to 2.6% in 2027, reflecting a tight labour market and robust wage growth.
Canada’s 2026 growth forecast has been cut from 1.2% in June to 0.9%, and the 2027 outlook lowered from 1.7% to 1.3%, mainly due to new US tariffs on Canadian exports.

items.title: AI購物代理風潮席捲 多國銀行警告詐騙與隱私風險
items.title_en: AI Shopping Agent Wave Sweeps Across Nations; Banks Warn of Fraud and Privacy Risks
paras: 包含美國銀行、英國國民西敏寺銀行(NatWest)、ING 及 Capital One 等多家金融機構周二(22日)表示，AI 購物技術的發展速度已超越產業標準與消費者保護規範，可能會增加詐騙、詐欺和資料隱私洩露的風險。同時，這些銀行也制定了開發此技術的原則。
隨著 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 及 Meta 等科技巨頭積極推廣 AI 購物工具，消費者利用 AI 代理人選購商品與進行支付的趨勢顯著加速。同時，零售商們也競相影響聊天機器人的推薦內容。
英國零售商 John Lewis 表示，來自 AI 代理的搜尋量在一年內已從 0.3% 成長至 2.5%，而且這一趨勢還在加速。
然而，銀行發表報告指出，AI 購物也讓消費者面臨買錯商品、過度消費，甚至遭遇詐騙與個資洩漏等風險。報告稱，「消費者不清楚AI是否會維護他們的利益。」
此外，AI 代理若要求輸入信用卡卡號並直接填入網站，或引導使用者採用保護力較弱的支付方式，也會引發安全疑慮。
對此，銀行團體向政策制定者提出多項建議原則，包括：交易涉及 AI 時須明確揭露、提高 AI 決策過程的透明度、加強客戶資料隱私保護，並確保消費者與商家能自由選擇服務且系統具備互操作性。
paras_en: Several financial institutions, including Bank of America, NatWest, ING and Capital One, said on Tuesday (the 22nd) that the pace of AI shopping technology development has outstripped industry standards and consumer protection regulations, potentially increasing the risk of fraud, scams and data privacy breaches. At the same time, these banks have also set out principles for developing the technology.

As tech giants such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta actively promote AI shopping tools, the trend of consumers using AI agents to select products and make payments is accelerating sharply. Retailers are also racing to influence the recommendations of chatbots.
UK retailer John Lewis said that searches originating from AI agents have grown from 0.3% to 2.5% within a year, and the trend is still accelerating.

However, the banks’ report points out that AI shopping also exposes consumers to risks such as buying the wrong product, overspending, and even falling victim to fraud and personal data leaks. The report states that “consumers are unclear whether AI will safeguard their interests.”
In addition, security concerns arise when AI agents request credit‑card numbers and auto‑fill them on websites, or steer users toward payment methods with weaker protection.

In response, the banking group has presented policymakers with several recommended principles, including clear disclosure when transactions involve AI, greater transparency of AI decision‑making processes, stronger protection of customer data privacy, and ensuring that consumers and merchants can freely choose services while the system remains interoperable.

items.title: 美債破10%將漲50%！Strive執行長：若美元債務危機加劇 比特幣市值可「無限上升」
items.title_en: U.S. Bonds Break 10% and Could Rise 50%: Strive CEO Says Bitcoin Market Cap Could "Rise Indefinitely" if Dollar Debt Crisis Worsens
paras: Strive執行長Matt Cole最近在《彭博電視》上提出一個顛覆性的估值框架：驅動比特幣市值上升的核心變數並非其2100萬枚的稀缺上限，而是日益惡化的美元債務危機，這一看法把比特幣價值重估邏輯從「供給端稀缺」轉向「法幣信用崩塌風險」，也就是把主權貨幣體系的償付壓力轉化為對硬資產的需求。
Cole表示，貨幣市場基金根本跑不贏法幣貶值速度，其給出的年化貶值率為6%至7%，而1980年至2020年長達40年的美債牛市，正是靠不斷走低的利率撐起固定收益回報。
Strive發行的SATA.US優先股在今年已跑贏比特幣100%以上，其設計邏輯為每日派息、底層資產為比特幣，以現金流壓降持有期間的價格波動感。自去年11月推出時保留12個月現金儲備，目前已增至18個月，即便不出售任何一枚比特幣也可維持營運至2027年底。
Strive此前估計2030年50%的年複合成長率，Cole則承認是「保守估計」。他並指出，該預測基於上月宣布熊市結束時的判斷。他在8月25日發文回顧ASST走勢，稱2月19日為熊市底部，並稱公司普通股已「全速運轉」，甚至看好未來4至5年比特幣「很輕鬆就能突破50萬美元」，黃金、白銀也會大幅走高，但關鍵是不能用當下美元價值衡量未來。
長期利率的穩定被他視為「延後而非解決」。Cole認為，目前長端利率得以穩定，得益於美國財長貝森特的干預，但兩黨均無意削減開支，這一緩和只是推遲危機。若Fed與美國財政部徹底退出債市，10年債殖利率可能突破10%。一旦高債務最終推動實際利率下行、金融體系流動性增加、美元長期走弱，比特幣將成潛在受益者。
對比SATA與比特幣同期的表現，則構成Cole反駁「託管模式衰落論」的直接證據。他認為，受挫的是缺乏紀律的公司，而非這一模式本身。
根據美國證交會(SEC)文件，Strive於9月14日至18日購入1355枚比特幣，均價約7.9475萬美元，持倉由2.5萬枚增至26355枚，同期現金儲備增加2540萬美元至2.296億美元；8月24日至28日也曾以每枚79431美元均價買入1800枚，使持倉升至23156枚，在BitcoinTreasuries的上市公司持股排名中超越Bullish升至第五位。

但Cole判斷存在明顯爭議。一方面，他同時看空美債，而SATA約13%的浮動收益率、每個工作日派息的設計，本質是用高頻派息吸引收益型投資者，而這類結構在槓桿驅動下恐觸發強制賣出與連鎖下跌，STRC與SATA年初的脫錨波動已暴露這一風險。另一方面，SATA的融資結構與比特幣價格高度綁定，可持續性取決於幣價能否跑贏證券資金成本。本質上，這是對美國財政狀況惡化的長期押注，收益取決於未來幾年債券市場與美元的演變路徑。
paras_en: Strive CEO Matt Cole recently presented a disruptive valuation framework on Bloomberg TV: the core driver of Bitcoin’s market‑cap growth is not its 21 million‑coin scarcity ceiling, but the worsening U.S. dollar debt crisis. This view shifts Bitcoin’s value‑re‑assessment logic from “supply‑side scarcity” to “sovereign fiat credit‑collapse risk,” turning sovereign monetary repayment pressure into demand for hard assets.

Cole said money‑market funds simply cannot outpace fiat depreciation, which he estimates at an annual 6‑7% loss. The 40‑year U.S. Treasury bull market from 1980 to 2020 was sustained by ever‑lower rates that supported fixed‑income returns.

Strive’s SATA.US preferred shares have outperformed Bitcoin by more than 100% this year. The product is designed to pay daily dividends, is backed by Bitcoin as the underlying asset, and uses cash‑flow to dampen price volatility during the holding period. Launched in November last year with a 12‑month cash reserve, the reserve has now been increased to 18 months, allowing operations to continue through the end of 2027 even without selling a single Bitcoin.

Strive previously projected a 50% annual compound growth rate through 2030, which Cole now admits was a “conservative estimate.” He noted the forecast was based on the judgment made when the bear market was declared over last month. In a post on August 25 he reviewed the ASST trend, calling February 19 the bear‑market bottom, saying the company’s common stock is now “running at full speed,” and even forecasting that Bitcoin could “easily break $500,000” within the next four to five years, with gold and silver also soaring—but the key is not to measure the future with today’s dollar value.

He views long‑term rate stability as a postponement rather than a solution. Cole believes current long‑end rate stability is thanks to Treasury Secretary Vincent’s intervention, yet both parties have no intention of cutting spending, making the easing only a delay. If the Fed and Treasury fully exit the bond market, the 10‑year yield could breach 10%. Should high debt eventually push real rates down, increase financial‑system liquidity and weaken the dollar long‑term, Bitcoin would become a potential beneficiary.

Comparing SATA’s performance with Bitcoin’s over the same period provides Cole’s direct refutation of the “custody‑model decline” narrative. He argues that it is undisciplined companies that suffer, not the custody model itself.

According to SEC filings, Strive bought 1,355 BTC between September 14‑18 at an average price of $79,475, raising its holdings from 25,000 BTC to 26,355 BTC. Cash reserves grew by $25.4 million to $229.6 million in the same window; it also purchased 1,800 BTC from August 24‑28 at an average of $79,431, lifting holdings to 23,156 BTC and moving the company up to fifth place in the BitcoinTreasuries listed‑company ranking, overtaking Bullish.

Cole acknowledges clear controversy. On one hand, he is bearish on U.S. Treasuries, while SATA’s roughly 13% floating yield and daily‑payout design essentially use high‑frequency distributions to attract yield‑seeking investors—a structure that, when leveraged, could trigger forced selling and cascading declines, a risk already exposed by the early‑year anchoring volatility of STRC and SATA. On the other hand, SATA’s financing is tightly tied to Bitcoin’s price, so its sustainability depends on the crypto out‑performing the cost of capital. Fundamentally, it is a long‑term bet on deteriorating U.S. fiscal health, with returns hinging on how bond markets and the dollar evolve over the coming years.

items.title: 長江存儲3D NAND專利戰在德國獲勝 美光遭禁售
items.title_en: Yangtze Memory 3D NAND Patent Fight Wins in Germany, Micron Barred from Sale
paras: 德國慕尼黑第一地區法院第七民事庭近日就長江存儲控訴美光(MU-US)專利侵權案作出裁決，認定美光侵犯長江存儲兩項德國實用新型權，並核發禁制令，要求美光停止在德國銷售涉案侵權產品。
此項裁決為雙方自 2023 年 11 月爆發全球專利爭端以來，長江存儲首度取得的實質性禁令勝訴。
本次裁決涉及的兩項德國實用新型，分別為「三維儲存元件的階梯結構」(DE202020006166U1)與「三維 NAND 記憶體中字線接觸的阻擋層」(DE202021004551U1)，主要涵蓋 3D NAND 快閃記憶體製造技術。慕尼黑地方法院針對長江存儲提起的另外三起訴訟(包含兩項實用新型與一項歐洲專利 EP3931868)，則裁定延期審理。
針對法院判決，美光方面迅速發表聲明表示不服並已提起上訴。美光強調，德國實用新型屬於未經實質審查、保護期最高 10 年的權利，美光正透過相關程序挑戰其有效性，並重申自身擁有逾 6.2 萬項專利技術。
法律分析人士指出，禁制令的實際執行將取決於慕尼黑高等地區法院在上訴程序中是否裁定暫停執行；若未被暫停，長江存儲即可啟動執行程序。
智慧財產權分析媒體《ip fray》創辦人 Florian Mueller 指出，此判決是長江存儲取得的突破，能在雙方龐大的全球專利爭端中提供重要談判槓桿。報導顯示，雙方訴訟已延伸至美國加州與德州聯邦法院、英國高等法院及歐洲統一專利法院(UPC)；美光並於 2026 年 9 月在美國愛達荷州地方法院反訴長江存儲涉嫌侵害營業祕密。
市場研調機構 TrendForce 數據顯示，2026 年第一季長江存儲在全球 NAND 快閃記憶體市場的銷售額與出貨量均位居全球第三。
paras_en: The Munich First Regional Court's Seventh Civil Chamber recently ruled on Yangtze Memory's patent infringement lawsuit against Micron (MU-US), finding that Micron infringed two of Yangtze Memory's German utility model rights and issuing an injunction that requires Micron to stop selling the infringing products in Germany.
This ruling marks Yangtze Memory's first substantive injunction victory since the global patent dispute erupted in November 2023.

The two German utility models involved are the “staircase structure of a three‑dimensional storage element” (DE202020006166U1) and the “blocking layer for word‑line contacts in three‑dimensional NAND memory” (DE202021004551U1), both covering 3D NAND flash manufacturing technology. The Munich Regional Court postponed three other lawsuits filed by Yangtze Memory (two additional utility models and European patent EP3931868).

Micron quickly issued a statement expressing disagreement and has filed an appeal. Micron stressed that German utility models are unexamined rights with a maximum protection term of ten years, that it is challenging their validity through the appropriate procedures, and reiterated that it holds over 62,000 patented technologies.

Legal analysts note that the actual enforcement of the injunction will depend on whether the Munich Higher Regional Court suspends execution during the appeal; if it is not suspended, Yangtze Memory can proceed with enforcement actions.

Florian Mueller, founder of the IP analysis outlet “ip fray,” said the decision is a breakthrough for Yangtze Memory, providing significant negotiating leverage in the massive global patent dispute. The litigation has expanded to U.S. federal courts in California and Texas, the UK High Court, and the Unified Patent Court (UPC); Micron also filed a counter‑claim in September 2026 in the Idaho federal court alleging trade‑secret infringement by Yangtze Memory.
TrendForce data shows that in the first quarter of 2026, Yangtze Memory ranked third worldwide in both sales revenue and shipment volume in the global NAND flash memory market.

items.title: 2027年全美大學排名出爐！ 指標迎歷史級重塑首納「就業回報」　普林斯頓15年神話破滅、MIT登頂
items.title_en: 2027 U.S. College Rankings Released! Metrics Undergo Historic Overhaul, Adding “Employment Return” for the First Time – Princeton’s 15‑Year Reign Ends, MIT Takes the Top Spot
paras: 《美國新聞與世界報導》公布2027全美最佳大學排名，麻省理工學院(MIT)首度登頂，打破普林斯頓自2012年版起連續15年霸榜格局。
根據最新排名，綜合大學前十名依序為MIT、普林斯頓、哈佛、耶魯，加州理工學院與史丹佛大學並列第五，賓大第七，杜克第八，約翰霍普金斯、西北、芝加哥並列第九。哥倫比亞、達特茅斯第十二，卡內基梅隆、康乃爾第十四。
《美國新聞與世界報導》表示，改版回應了學費高漲與投報率疑慮。對申請家庭而言，單看綜合名次已不夠，選校應同時核對目標專業薪資、畢業率、低收入生支持與地區產業連結，避免被短期洗牌誤導。
