這項最新排名被教育界稱為近十年最顛覆，主因在指標重構。首先，排名首度納入「分專業畢業收入」，沿用美國教育部College Scorecard畢業4年各學門實際薪資，按領域同類對比，取代原有畢業負債指標，此舉對電腦、工程、量化金融就業轉化強的學校是利多，也是MIT登頂關鍵。
其次，「學生產出成果」權重逾50%，含畢業率、大一留校率、佩爾獎學金學生社會流動與起薪等硬指標。第三，卡內基分類調整，約20%學校重新分組，商科、工科、醫學專項校首度更完整納入綜合評比，歷史名次不宜直接縱比。第四，佩爾獎學金學生占比與畢業轉化權重上升，成為前25名拉鋸重點。
文理學院方面，威廉斯、阿默斯特續分列榜首與探花；公立學校以柏克萊、UCLA並列最佳，聖路易華盛頓大學、范德堡、萊斯等十六名群聚。
整體排名給出的信號是從「聲譽與資源」轉向「就業回報與社會流動」的排名。
paras_en: U.S. News & World Report released the 2027 Best Colleges ranking, with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) topping the list for the first time, ending Princeton’s 15‑year streak that began with the 2012 edition.

According to the latest ranking, the top ten schools overall are, in order: MIT, Princeton, Harvard, Yale, Caltech and Stanford tied for fifth, Penn in seventh, Duke in eighth, Johns Hopkins, Northwestern and Chicago tied for ninth. Columbia and Dartmouth are twelfth, Carnegie Mellon and Cornell are fourteenth.

U.S. News & World Report said the redesign responds to soaring tuition and concerns about return on investment. For applicant families, looking only at the overall rank is no longer enough; school selection should also verify target‑major salaries, graduation rates, low‑income student support and regional industry connections to avoid being misled by short‑term shuffles.

The new ranking has been called the most disruptive in a decade, mainly because of the metric overhaul. For the first time it includes “major‑specific graduate earnings,” using the Department of Education’s College Scorecard data on four‑year post‑graduation salaries by discipline, compared within fields, replacing the previous debt‑based metric. This benefits schools strong in computer science, engineering and quantitative finance and was a key factor in MIT’s ascent.

In addition, “student outcomes” now carry more than 50% weight, encompassing graduation rates, first‑year retention, Pell‑Grant student social mobility and starting salaries, among other hard indicators. A third change is the adjustment of Carnegie classifications, with about 20% of schools re‑grouped; business, engineering and medical specialty schools are now fully incorporated into the overall assessment, making historical rank comparisons inappropriate. A fourth change is the increased weight on the proportion of Pell‑Grant students and graduation conversion, making these metrics a focal point in the battle for the top 25 spots.

In the liberal‑arts segment, Williams and Amherst continue to occupy the top two spots, while public institutions Berkeley and UCLA tie as the best public schools. Washington University in St. Louis, Vanderbilt, Rice and other schools make up a cluster of sixteen institutions in the middle of the list.
The overall signal of the ranking is a shift from emphasizing “reputation and resources” to focusing on “employment return and social mobility.”

items.title: 花旗點名三大市場醞釀「空單回補」
items.title_en: Citi Flags Three Major Markets Ripe for Short Covering
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，花旗警告，全球股市投資人上週進一步降低風險部位，空頭部位在多個市場重新增加，尤以美國小型股、歐洲及部分亞洲市場最為明顯。目前部分空單已陷入虧損，一旦市場出現利多，日經指數、南韓 KOSPI 指數及標普 500 指數可能出現較大規模的空單回補行情。
由策略師 David Chew 領軍的花旗團隊指出，歐洲Stoxx 50指數及美國大型股的淨部位仍相對穩健，但投資人持續削減方向性風險，反映市場情緒轉弱。多個市場累積大量空頭部位，也使後續走勢呈現不對稱風險。
這波部位降溫發生在聯準會 (Fed) 3 年來首次升息、日本央行進一步調整政策、能源價格上漲及地緣政治緊張之際。花旗形容，這些因素共同引發本輪利率週期以來最同步的避險浪潮之一。
美國市場方面，三大主要股指均出現偏空資金流向，主要源自投資人新建空單，而非撤出多頭部位。其中，羅素 2000 指數的部位單週降幅居花旗追蹤的全球市場之首，目前所有剩餘多單都處於虧損。
相較之下，標普 500 指數及那斯達克指數展現較強韌性，持續出現的空單回補抵銷大部分偏空壓力。
花旗指出，標普 500 指數約 80% 的多單與空單目前均處於虧損，但由於空頭部位規模較大，市場風險明顯偏向空單回補。即使指數僅溫和反彈，也可能促使空頭平倉，帶來額外買盤。
歐洲方面，德國 DAX 指數及歐洲銀行股指數因新空單增加，部位轉為輕度偏空。歐洲斯托克指數雖出現區內最大規模的資金流出，整體部位仍保持偏多。
花旗認為，歐洲市場的主要風險正由方向判斷轉向部位壓力。多數指數的多頭部位已陷入虧損，其中 DAX 的損益結構在歐洲市場中最弱。
亞洲仍是全球部位最偏空的地區。日經指數的空頭傾向雖略有改善，但仍是主要市場中部位最偏空者；投資人也進一步增加南韓 KOSPI、香港恆生指數及中國 A50 指數的空單。
日經指數、KOSPI及恆生指數的空頭部位均接近歷史高檔，其中日經與KOSPI超過 40% 的空單已陷入虧損。花旗表示，任何正面催化劑都可能引發幅度不成比例的空單回補漲勢，日經指數面臨的風險尤其突出。
paras_en: Citi warned that global equity investors further reduced risk positions last week, short positions increased in several markets, especially U.S. small‑cap stocks, Europe and some Asian markets. Some shorts are now in loss; if the market receives positive news, the Nikkei, South Korea KOSPI and S&P 500 could see large short‑covering rallies.

Led by strategist David Chew, the Citi team said net positions in the European Stoxx 50 and U.S. large‑cap stocks remain relatively solid, but investors continue cutting directional risk, reflecting weaker market sentiment. Accumulated large short positions in many markets create asymmetric risk.

This cooling of positions occurs as the Fed implements its first rate hike in three years, the Bank of Japan further adjusts policy, energy prices rise and geopolitical tensions heighten. Citi describes these factors as sparking one of the most synchronized hedging waves of the current rate‑cycle.

In U.S. markets, all three major indices showed net short flows, mainly from investors opening new shorts rather than unwinding longs. The Russell 2000’s position fell the most in a single week among Citi‑tracked global markets, and all remaining long positions are now in loss.
By contrast, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq displayed greater resilience, with ongoing short covering offsetting most of the bearish pressure.

Citi notes that about 80% of both long and short positions in the S&P 500 are currently losing, but because short size is larger, market risk leans toward short covering. Even a modest rebound could trigger short liquidation and add buying pressure.

In Europe, Germany’s DAX and the European banking index turned lightly short as new shorts were added. The European Stoxx index saw the region’s biggest fund outflow, yet its overall position remains net long.

Citi believes the main risk in Europe is shifting from directional bets to position pressure. Most index long positions are in loss, with the DAX having the weakest profit‑loss structure among European markets.

Asia remains the most short‑biased region globally. The Nikkei’s short tilt has slightly improved but still is the most short‑biased among major markets; investors also added shorts on South Korea’s KOSPI, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng and China A50 indices.

Short positions in the Nikkei, KOSPI and Hang Seng are near historic highs, with over 40% of shorts on the Nikkei and KOSPI already in loss. Citi says any positive catalyst could spark a disproportionately large short‑covering rally, with the Nikkei’s risk especially pronounced.

items.title: 休市錯過全球AI大漲？日股周四開盤拚補漲
items.title_en: Missed the Global AI Surge During the Holiday? Japanese Stocks Aim to Recover on Thursday Opening
paras: 日本股市結束「白銀周」連假，周四(24日)恢復交易。全球人工智慧(AI)概念股本周重拾漲勢，日股有望補漲；但日元持續走貶，也讓市場緊盯日本當局是否干預匯市。大阪交易的日經225指數12月期貨，已較上周五現貨收盤水準高出約2.5%。日本公債則受油價下跌與日銀(日本央行/BOJ)升息前景牽動，走勢較難判斷。

AI熱潮再起 半導體股可望領漲

Meta Platforms(META-US)新推出的AI代理初步展現成效，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)也發表號稱中國性能最強的AI晶片，帶動全球AI交易回溫。此前美國主要AI業者呼籲放慢開發速度，一度令市場擔憂產業成長；如今美股那斯達克100指數周二在晶片股帶動下，創下6月以來首個新高。

Vantage Global Prime分析師Hebe Chen指出，AI股反彈、風險情緒改善與油價回落，為日股提供補漲空間，也暫緩通膨與利率壓力。iFast Financial分析師Hu You預期，東京威力科創(8035-JP)、愛德萬測試(6857-JP)等晶片設備商可望受惠，揖斐電(IBIDEN)(4062-JP)與鎧俠(285A-JP)也可能走高。日經225指數截至9月18日的五個交易日上漲1.6%，為約一個月來最佳單周表現。

日元連貶添干預變數 債市觀望日銀

日銀上周五升息，並表明仍可能進一步緊縮，但欠缺明確指引，令日元交易員失望。日元當天一度貶1.3%至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後因《日本經濟新聞》報導日銀向市場詢問匯價而收斂跌幅。詢價常被視為可能干預的前兆，但賣壓其後再起。日元周三東京時間傍晚報157.88，朝連跌第四天邁進，若成真將是8月下旬以來最長連跌；選擇權市場也顯示，投資人加強防範干預後日元反彈。
布蘭特原油跌破每桶100美元、美國公債殖利率本周走低，原可支撐日債，日銀政策的不確定性卻可能抵銷利多。Hu You認為，升息墊高短期利率底部，短天期日債價格將承壓。《彭博》經濟學家木村太郎指出，日銀總裁植田和男態度比預期更鷹派，強調基礎通膨正接近2%目標，卻鮮少談及疲弱日元。
本周川普與中國國家主席習近平的會晤，也是市場焦點。Chen提醒，日元貶值起初有利出口股，若持續推升通膨與升息預期，日債恐再度承壓。
paras_en: Japan's stock market resumes trading on Thursday (the 24th) after the "Silver Week" holiday. Global AI‑related stocks have reclaimed their upward momentum this week, giving Japanese equities a chance to catch up; however, the yen’s continued depreciation keeps the market watching to see whether Japanese authorities will intervene in the FX market. Osaka‑traded December Nikkei 225 futures are about 2.5% higher than the spot closing level on Friday. Japanese government bonds are harder to read, being influenced by falling oil prices and the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) tightening outlook.

The AI boom is back, and semiconductor stocks are set to lead the rally. Meta Platforms (META‑US) has rolled out a new AI assistant that is already showing results, and Alibaba (BABA‑US) announced what it claims is China’s most powerful AI chip, reviving global AI trading activity. Earlier, major U.S. AI firms had urged a slowdown in development, sparking concerns about industry growth; now, the Nasdaq‑100 hit its first new high since June on Tuesday, driven by chip stocks.

Vantage Global Prime analyst Hebe Chen notes that the rebound in AI stocks, improved risk sentiment and lower oil prices give Japanese equities room to recover and temporarily ease inflation and rate pressures. iFast Financial analyst Hu You expects chip‑equipment makers such as Tokyo‑based Tokyo Electron (8035‑JP) and Advantest (6857‑JP) to benefit, while IBIDEN (4062‑JP) and KAI‑X (285A‑JP) could also rise. The Nikkei 225 had risen 1.6% over the five trading days ending September 18, its best weekly performance in about a month.

The yen’s continued slide adds an intervention variable, leaving the bond market on hold for the BOJ. The BOJ raised rates last Friday and signaled that further tightening is possible, but offered no clear guidance, disappointing yen traders. The currency fell as much as 1.3% that day to ¥158.05 per dollar before retracing after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had queried the market on exchange rates – a move often seen as a pre‑emptive sign of possible intervention, though selling pressure resumed afterward. By Wednesday evening Tokyo time the yen was at ¥157.88, marking a fourth consecutive decline and potentially the longest streak since late August; options markets also show investors hedging against a post‑intervention yen rebound.

Brent crude slipped below $100 a barrel and U.S. Treasury yields fell this week, which could have supported Japanese bonds, but uncertainty around BOJ policy may offset the upside. Hu You believes that rate hikes have lifted the short‑term rate floor, putting pressure on short‑dated Japanese bond prices. Bloomberg economist Taro Kimura points out that BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda’s stance is more hawkish than expected, emphasizing that core inflation is nearing the 2% target while giving little comment on the weak yen.

This week’s meeting between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping is also a market focus. Chen warns that an initially export‑friendly yen depreciation could, if it persists, push up inflation and rate‑hike expectations, putting Japanese bonds under renewed pressure.

items.title: 川普威脅毀滅伊朗 又稱會談良好 伊朗回應：說明美國陷入絕境
items.title_en: Trump Threatens Iran’s Destruction, Claims Talks Were Good; Iran Responds: America Is in a Dire Situation
paras: 美國總統川普於聯合國大會發表演說，對伊朗發出極端警告，稱伊朗正面臨「偉大或徹底毀滅」的選擇，若未達成協議將短時間內「毀滅」伊朗，並重申絕不允許伊朗取得核武。
然而在演說後，川普卻向媒體透露，美方特使威特考夫(Steve Witkoff)與庫許納(Jared Kushner)已在場邊與伊朗外交部長阿拉格奇(Abbas Araghchi)等人舉行長達三小時「非常好且具建設性」的會談，並預告近期將再次會晤。
面對美方言論，伊朗官方與軍方強硬反駁。伊朗武裝部隊總參謀部發表聲明，指責川普企圖為侵略辯護，其咆哮正顯示美國對伊朗的侵略已面臨「戰略死胡同」與「絕望」。
另一方面，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)地面部隊司令卡拉米少將(Mohammad Karami)強調，伊朗「絕不會向敵人退讓半步」，將持續堅持抵抗。
針對重啟荷姆茲海峽，伊朗官員堅持美方必須立即解除制裁、停止海上封鎖並解凍資產，並提議若美方減輕軍事壓力，可在七天內解除海峽封鎖。
對於川普的威脅言論，半島電視台美國首席特派員Alan Fisher指出，這種強硬威脅與秘密談判並存呈現「奇特並置」，但也散發出邁向和平協議的樂觀氣氛。
阿拉伯觀點研究所創辦主任Zeidon Alkinani表示，川普自開戰以來發言極具矛盾，作為「交易型人物」，若無法依其條件達成協議便威脅開戰；而美方在與以色列發動戰爭後，正迫切尋求能向國內與國際宣傳的「象徵性勝利」。
國際特赦組織秘書長Agnes Callamard不滿川普的說法，她認為，威脅消滅整個國家人口「已可能構成國際法上的種族滅絕威脅」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a speech at the United Nations General Assembly, issuing an extreme warning to Iran and saying the country faces a choice between "greatness or total destruction"; if an agreement is not reached, he warned that Iran would be "destroyed" in a short period and reiterated that the United States will never allow Iran to acquire nuclear weapons.

After the speech, however, Trump told the media that U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had held a three‑hour "very good and constructive" meeting on the sidelines with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and others, and announced that they would meet again soon.

In response to the U.S. statements, Iran’s officials and military issued a forceful rebuttal. The General Staff of the Iranian Armed Forces released a statement accusing Trump of trying to justify aggression, saying his roar shows that U.S. aggression toward Iran has reached a "strategic dead end" and "despair."

Meanwhile, Major General Mohammad Karami, commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) ground forces, stressed that Iran "will not concede a single step to the enemy" and will continue to resist.

Regarding the reopening of the Hormuz Strait, Iranian officials insisted that the United States must immediately lift sanctions, end the maritime blockade and unfreeze assets, and suggested that if the U.S. eases military pressure, the blockade could be lifted within seven days.

Commenting on Trump’s threatening remarks, Alan Fisher, Al Jazeera’s chief U.S. correspondent, said the coexistence of hard‑line threats and secret negotiations creates a "strange juxtaposition," but also emits an optimistic atmosphere toward a peace agreement.

Zeidon Alkinani, founder and director of the Arab Viewpoint Institute, said Trump’s statements have been highly contradictory since the war began; as a "transactional figure," he threatens war when his conditions are not met, and after the U.S. launched a war with Israel, it is now urgently seeking a "symbolic victory" to promote domestically and internationally.

Amnesty International Secretary‑General Agnes Callamard expressed displeasure with Trump’s remarks, stating that threatening to wipe out an entire nation’s population "could already constitute a threat of genocide under international law."

items.title: 油價飆也擋不住！歐元區9月企業活動創逾三年新高 ECB下月再升息有底氣
items.title_en: Rising Oil Prices Can't Stop It! Eurozone September Business Activity Hits Over Three-Year High, Giving ECB Confidence for Another Rate Hike Next Month
paras: 歐元區9月民間企業活動意外加速，擴張速度創逾三年新高。服務業回溫，加上製造業持續成長，顯示經濟迄今仍能抵禦美伊戰爭推升能源價格的衝擊，但企業成本與物價壓力同步上升，也讓歐洲央行(ECB)再度升息的可能性提高。
綜合外媒周三(23日)報導，標普全球(S&P Global)公布，歐元區9月綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)初值由8月的52.0升至53.1，為2023年4月以來最高，優於市場預期的51.7。指數高於50代表企業活動擴張。
服務業PMI由51.6升至53.0，創近一年新高，原先市場預期會降至51.5；製造業PMI則持平於52.7，但納入綜合指數的製造業產出指標由53.3小升至53.4。整體新訂單以逾四年來最快速度增加，出口訂單也持續成長，帶動企業增聘人手。
歐元區兩大經濟體表現也優於預期。德國企業活動擴張速度為2025年10月以來最快，法國則意外寫下逾兩年來最強勁的成長。標普全球首席商業經濟學家威廉森(Chris Williamson)表示，AI與國防支出帶動以德國為首的製造業，服務業也開始回溫，反映經濟改善範圍擴大。
然而，能源漲價正推高企業投入成本，部分業者已將成本轉嫁給客戶。威廉森指出，9月通膨壓力再起並不令人意外；經濟在地緣政治風險與物價上漲下保持韌性，可能讓ECB更有信心在年底前再度升息，10月升息也已成為可能選項。
ECB本月已升息，為美伊戰爭爆發後第二次，並將今年歐元區成長預測上修至0.9%。經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)周三也將歐元區2026年成長預測上調0.2個百分點至1%，但下修法國預測至僅成長0.4%。《彭博》經濟研究則預期，ECB將於12月進行最後一次升息。
paras_en: Eurozone private sector activity accelerated unexpectedly in September, with expansion reaching a three‑year high. A warming services sector and continued growth in manufacturing show the economy can still withstand the shock of higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war, but rising corporate costs and price pressures also increase the likelihood of another ECB rate hike.

According to a composite report from S&P Global on Wednesday (the 23rd), the Eurozone’s flash composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for September rose from 52.0 in August to 53.1, the highest since April 2023 and above the market forecast of 51.7. A reading above 50 indicates expansion in business activity.

The services PMI climbed from 51.6 to 53.0, a near‑year high, while the market had expected it to fall to 51.5; the manufacturing PMI held steady at 52.7, and the manufacturing output component of the composite index edged up from 53.3 to 53.4. Overall, new orders grew at the fastest pace in more than four years, export orders kept rising, and firms are hiring more staff.

The two biggest Eurozone economies also outperformed expectations. German business activity expanded at the fastest rate since October 2025, and France posted its strongest growth in over two years. S&P Global chief business economist Chris Williamson said AI and defence spending are driving manufacturing led by Germany, while services are beginning to recover, reflecting a broader economic improvement.

However, higher energy prices are pushing up corporate input costs, and some firms have already passed these costs onto customers. Williamson noted that a resurgence of inflationary pressure in September is not surprising; the economy’s resilience amid geopolitical risk and price hikes could give the ECB more confidence to raise rates again before year‑end, making an October hike a plausible option.

The ECB raised rates this month, its second hike since the outbreak of the US‑Iran conflict, and upgraded its 2024 Eurozone growth forecast to 0.9%. The OECD also lifted its 2026 Eurozone growth projection by 0.2 percentage points to 1% on Wednesday, while cutting France’s forecast to just 0.4% growth. Bloomberg Economics expects the ECB’s final rate hike to come in December.

items.title: 輝達加速東南亞主權AI落地 擴大導入政府與智慧城市
items.title_en: NVIDIA Accelerates Sovereign AI Deployment in Southeast Asia, Expanding Government and Smart City Adoption
paras: AI逐步成為各國國家戰略的重要一環，隨著各國政府積極將AI從試點階段推向實際部署，如何建立符合在地語言、文化、政策優先順序與經濟需求的AI能力，成為發展重點。輝達(NVDA-US)今(23)日表示，正透過技術、基礎設施、生態系與專業能力，協助東南亞各國推進AI國家布局。
為加速東南亞AI轉型，NVIDIA正藉由開放模型、開發者工具及合作夥伴生態系，協助各國將AI由實驗階段導入生產級應用，並聚焦政府營運與公共服務、AI驅動民眾服務及企業應用、關鍵基礎設施與公共安全，以及新創、開發者與研究能量等四大領域。
在新加坡，新加坡內政科技局(HTX)正運用NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super及Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型進行研究，推動AI在公共安全領域的應用。其中，Nemotron 3 Super可望支援複雜推理與代理型工作流程，Nemotron 3 Nano Omni則整合視覺、音訊與語言能力，可用於開發以真實世界營運資料為基礎的多模態應用。
NVIDIA指出，兩款模型搭配使用，可進一步強化HTX在新加坡內政團隊部署安全、且由在地自主掌控AI的能力。
企業端方面，恩士迅(NCS)正導入Nemotron模型與NVIDIA VSS Blueprint，加速企業與公部門採用代理型AI，同時推動物理AI應用於人形機器人，以因應安全性、即時回應及資料治理需求。
ST Engineering則利用NVIDIA NeMo工具與NVIDIA cuOpt軟體開發AI Studio平台，並將代理型AI解決方案導入旗下業務，包括船舶維修、翻修與大修（Marine MRO）等應用場景。
相關AI布局也逐步擴展至東南亞其他市場。馬來西亞YTL AI Labs正針對企業與公民服務微調Nemotron模型，Viettel AI則針對越南語應用進行模型微調。
泰國方面，參與泰國大型語言模型專案（ThaiLLM）的Big Data Institute與iApp Technology，正探索以Nemotron作為基礎模型。其中，iApp Technology初期鎖定法律應用，透過NVIDIA NeMo框架，以泰語法律資料微調OpenThai 2.0 Legal，進一步調整Nemotron 3 Nano。
該模型目前以開源形式提供給泰國開發者社群，並作為iApp Technology旗下法律助理聊天機器人Thanoy的核心模型，目前已服務約4.3萬名使用者。
在汶萊，Antrique則建置AI創新平台，協助提升當地食品產業生產力。
除生成式與代理型AI外，NVIDIA也將相關技術延伸至智慧城市應用。NVIDIA Cosmos開放世界模型與NVIDIA VSS Blueprint目前正於東南亞推動智慧城市解決方案，馬來西亞ITMAX結合Cosmos與VSS改善城市交通營運，泰國AS-TECH則採用相同技術架構，改善機場旅客動線。
NVIDIA表示，將持續透過模型、工具與合作夥伴生態系，推動東南亞各國AI應用從實驗階段邁向實際部署。
paras_en: AI is increasingly becoming a key component of national strategies worldwide. As governments push AI from pilot stages to real-world deployment, the focus is on building capabilities that align with local languages, cultures, policy priorities, and economic needs. NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced today that it is helping Southeast Asian countries advance their AI national plans through technology, infrastructure, ecosystem, and expertise.

To accelerate AI transformation in Southeast Asia, NVIDIA is leveraging open models, developer tools, and partner ecosystems to help countries move AI from experimental to production-level applications. The company is focusing on four key areas: government operations and public services, AI-driven citizen services and enterprise applications, critical infrastructure and public safety, and innovation, developer, and research ecosystems.

In Singapore, the Home Affairs Technology (HTX) agency is using NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni models for research, driving AI applications in public safety. Nemotron 3 Super is expected to support complex reasoning and agent-based workflows, while Nemotron 3 Nano Omni integrates vision, audio, and language capabilities for multimodal applications built on real-world operational data.
NVIDIA notes that using the two models together can further strengthen HTX’s Singapore Home Affairs team’s ability to deploy secure, locally controlled AI.

On the corporate side, NCS is adopting Nemotron models and NVIDIA VSS Blueprint to accelerate enterprise and public sector adoption of agent-based AI, while also advancing physical AI applications in humanoid robots to meet safety, real-time response, and data governance needs.

ST Engineering is using NVIDIA NeMo tools and NVIDIA cuOpt software to develop an AI Studio platform, and is deploying agent-based AI solutions across its businesses, including marine MRO (maintenance, repair, and overhaul) applications.

AI initiatives are also expanding to other Southeast Asian markets. YTL AI Labs in Malaysia is fine-tuning Nemotron models for enterprise and citizen services, while Viettel AI is fine-tuning models for Vietnamese language applications.

In Thailand, the Big Data Institute and iApp Technology, participants in the ThaiLLM large language model project, are exploring Nemotron as a base model. iApp Technology initially focused on legal applications, fine-tuning OpenThai 2.0 Legal with the NVIDIA NeMo framework and further adjusting Nemotron 3 Nano for Thai legal data.

The model is currently available in open source to the Thai developer community and serves as the core model for iApp Technology’s legal assistant chatbot Thanoy, which already serves about 43,000 users.
In Brunei, Antrique has built an AI innovation platform to boost local food industry productivity.

Beyond generative and agent-based AI, NVIDIA is extending its technology to smart city applications. NVIDIA Cosmos open-world models and NVIDIA VSS Blueprint are currently being promoted in Southeast Asia for smart city solutions. Malaysia’s ITMAX combines Cosmos and VSS to improve urban traffic operations, while Thailand’s AS-TECH uses the same technology stack to enhance airport passenger flow.
NVIDIA says it will continue to drive Southeast Asian countries’ AI applications from experimental to real deployment through models, tools, and partner ecosystems.

items.title: 習近平專機啟程訪美！可能左右川習會四大分歧
items.title_en: Xi Jinping’s State Visit to the U.S. Takes Off – May Influence the Four Major Divides in the Xi‑Trump Summit
paras: 中國國家主席習近平 23 日下午乘專機離開北京，展開對美國的國是訪問。飛航追蹤網站顯示，編號 B-2482 的波音 747 當天下午約 2 時自北京起飛。習近平預計與美國總統川普舉行今年第二次會面；關稅休戰、伊朗局勢、對台軍售與人工智慧 (AI) 競爭，料將是觀察這場峰會的四大焦點。
《外交家》報導，川普與習近平將舉行今年第二次會面，這場峰會正值美國期中選舉前約 40 天，時機格外敏感。皮尤研究中心調查顯示，儘管美國民眾對習近平的觀感較去年改善 6 個百分點，多數人仍對他抱持負面看法。
國際局勢同樣緊張。美伊戰爭陰影籠罩市場，布蘭特原油價格仍在每桶 100 美元附近；中俄關係也持續深化，習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁數月前才重申雙方緊密夥伴關係，並簽署深化戰略夥伴關係的聯合聲明。
儘管外界對峰會能否取得重大成果期待不高，但關稅休戰、伊朗局勢、台灣軍售與人工智慧 (AI) 競爭等四大議題，仍可能牽動美中關係及亞洲安全架構。
首先是美中關稅休戰能否延長
川普與習近平 2025 年 10 月 30 日在南韓釜山出席亞太經合會 (APEC) 峰會期間，同意讓貿易戰休兵一年。美方把與芬太尼相關的中國商品關稅降至 10%，並暫停徵收 10% 對等關稅；北京則承諾至 2028 年每年採購 2,500 萬噸美國黃豆，並延後實施稀土出口管制。
這項休戰安排將於今年 11 月到期，但執行情況已出現疑問。報導指出，儘管中國承諾豁免相關出口管制，自 2025 年 4 月以來，供應美國航太及國防產業使用的稀土元素釔，出口量仍大幅下滑。
部分美國官員及分析人士已討論對特定中國商品加徵新關稅與費用，相關措施可能成為峰會前的談判籌碼。
第二項議題是伊朗
中東停火協議已多次破裂，伊朗一週多前為報復美軍打擊伊斯蘭革命衛隊，對約旦、巴林、科威特及伊拉克發動攻擊。
中國是伊朗最大貿易夥伴及最大石油買家。美國財政部近期啟動「經濟放逐行動」(Operation Economic Outcast)，將施壓重點放在被認定協助伊朗行動的相關方面。川普也表示，他曾直接與習近平討論此事，要求中國不要介入。
美中今年 5 月雖一致認為伊朗不應擁有核武，但這項有限共識目前已被雙方在其他議題上的緊張關係掩蓋。
第三項焦點是台灣
川普在今年 5 月峰會後，曾把美國對台軍售形容為「非常好的談判籌碼」，並暫緩推動相關交易。此番說法引發美國盟友疑慮，台灣總統賴清德隨即表示，台灣主權不能被「犧牲或交易」。
要求華府停止對台軍售，長期以來一直是北京的主要政策目標。分析指出，川普把對台軍售視為談判槓桿，而非台美關係的常態安排，可能促使習近平進一步鞏固這套交易式思維。
相關影響也不只限於台灣。菲律賓與中國目前仍在南海海域對峙，其中包括民主礁 (又稱黃岩島) 爭端。
《外交家》分析認為，若川普釋出願意為維持美中關係而讓步的訊號，東京、馬尼拉及其他盟友可能據此判斷，美國提供的安全承諾也可被納入談判，進而考驗美國在亞洲的整體同盟架構。
第四項議題是 AI
拜登政府時期，美國透過出口管制，實質禁止先進 AI 晶片流入中國；川普 2025 年 4 月一度進一步收緊限制，但在同年 12 月至 2026 年 1 月間改變政策，把輝達 H200 晶片對中出口規定，從原則上拒絕改為逐案審查。
中國企業隨後下訂數百萬顆 H200 晶片。川普將此舉定位為商業交易，而非國家安全問題，在美國國內引發反彈。
不過，嚴格的出口管制仍可能遭到規避。字節跳動、阿里巴巴 (BABA-US)及騰訊等中國大型企業，已透過日本、泰國及馬來西亞等第三國取得輝達晶片，而非直接輸入中國。
儘管中國 AI 技術整體仍落後美國，但受惠於開放權重策略與更高效率的模型，中國模型在全球 AI 使用量中的占比已明顯上升。報導認為，美國對中 AI 政策中的矛盾，可能在峰會期間進一步浮現。
至於外界期待的 AI 安全監管對話，取得實質進展的可能有限。
雖然先前有消息稱，美中可能在川習會前後舉行 AI 對話，但兩國都把彼此視為爭奪 AI 主導地位的主要競爭者，缺乏放慢發展速度的誘因。
paras_en: On the afternoon of the 23rd, Chinese President Xi Jinping boarded a state aircraft and left Beijing for a state visit to the United States. Flight‑tracking data show that Boeing 747 tail number B‑2482 took off from Beijing at about 2 p.m. local time. Xi is expected to meet President Donald Trump for their second summit this year; a tariff truce, the Iran situation, U.S. arms sales to Taiwan and competition in artificial intelligence (AI) are likely to be the four main focal points of the talks.

According to the magazine *Diplomat*, the second Xi‑Trump meeting this year comes roughly 40 days before the U.S. mid‑term elections, making the timing especially sensitive. A Pew Research Center poll shows that although Americans’ view of Xi improved by six percentage points compared with last year, a majority still hold a negative opinion of him.

The international environment is also tense. The shadow of a U.S.–Iran war hangs over markets, keeping Brent crude near $100 a barrel; meanwhile, China‑Russia ties continue to deepen. Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin reaffirmed their close partnership only months ago and signed a joint statement to deepen their strategic partnership.

Even though expectations are modest that the summit will produce major breakthroughs, the four issues of a tariff truce, Iran, Taiwan arms sales and AI competition could still shape U.S.–China relations and the security architecture of Asia.
First, whether the U.S.–China tariff truce can be extended.

During the APEC summit in Busan, South Korea on 30 October 2025, Trump and Xi agreed to a one‑year pause in the trade war. The United States reduced tariffs on Chinese goods linked to fentanyl to 10 % and suspended a reciprocal 10 % tariff; Beijing pledged to purchase 25 million tonnes of U.S. soybeans each year through 2028 and to delay the implementation of rare‑earth export controls.

That truce is set to expire in November this year, but its implementation is already in doubt. Reports note that although China promised to waive the relevant export controls, shipments of the rare‑earth element yttrium used by U.S. aerospace and defense firms have fallen sharply since April 2025.
Some U.S. officials and analysts have begun discussing new tariffs and fees on specific Chinese products, which could become bargaining chips ahead of the summit.
The second issue is Iran.

The Middle‑East cease‑fire agreements have repeatedly collapsed, and just over a week ago Iran launched attacks on Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait and Iraq in retaliation for a U.S. strike on the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

China is Iran’s largest trading partner and biggest oil buyer. The U.S. Treasury recently launched “Operation Economic Outcast,” targeting entities it deems to be assisting Iran. Trump also said he directly raised the matter with Xi, urging China not to intervene.
In May this year, the United States and China both agreed that Iran should not acquire nuclear weapons, but that limited consensus is now being eclipsed by growing tensions over other topics.
The third focus is Taiwan.

After the May summit, Trump described U.S. arms sales to Taiwan as “a very good negotiating lever” and paused related transactions. The comment alarmed U.S. allies, and Taiwanese President Lai Ching‑te quickly warned that Taiwan’s sovereignty cannot be “sacrificed or traded.”

Pressuring Washington to halt arms sales to Taiwan has long been Beijing’s primary policy goal. Analysts note that Trump’s view of the sales as a bargaining chip rather than a routine element of the U.S.–Taiwan relationship may push Xi to further entrench this transactional mindset.

The impact extends beyond Taiwan. The Philippines and China continue to confront each other in the South China Sea, including the dispute over the Second Thomas Shoal (also known as the Huangyan Island).

*Diplomat* analysis suggests that if Trump signals a willingness to make concessions to preserve U.S.–China ties, Tokyo, Manila and other allies may interpret that the U.S. security commitments are also up for negotiation, testing the overall alliance framework in Asia.
The fourth issue is AI.

During the Biden administration, the United States effectively banned the export of advanced AI chips to China through export controls; Trump tightened those restrictions in April 2025, but between December 2025 and January 2026 the policy was altered, changing the rule on Nvidia’s H200 chips from a blanket ban to case‑by‑case reviews.

Chinese firms subsequently placed orders for millions of H200 chips. Trump framed the move as a commercial transaction rather than a national‑security matter, sparking domestic backlash in the United States.

Nevertheless, strict export controls can still be circumvented. Large Chinese companies such as ByteDance, Alibaba (BABA‑US) and Tencent have obtained Nvidia chips via third‑party countries like Japan, Thailand and Malaysia instead of importing them directly into China.

Although China’s AI capabilities still lag behind the United States overall, the country’s share of global AI usage has risen noticeably thanks to open‑weight strategies and more efficient models. Reports say the contradictions in U.S. policy toward Chinese AI may become more apparent during the summit.
As for the much‑anticipated dialogue on AI safety regulation, the likelihood of substantive progress appears limited.

While earlier reports suggested that the U.S. and China might hold an AI dialogue around the time of the Xi‑Trump meeting, both sides view each other as the primary competitor for AI dominance and lack incentives to slow development.

items.title: 巴克萊：美期中選舉季節性效應浮現 但這兩項風險影響更大
items.title_en: Barclays: Seasonal Midterm Election Effect Appears, but Two Risks Matter More
paras: 巴克萊(Barclays)表示，股票市場目前正遵循歷史期中選舉前夕的典型季節性規律，但選舉對政策與市場的實際影響預計相對有限，油價與利率才是決定未來股市走勢的更關鍵因素。
以Emmanuel Cau為首的巴克萊策略團隊表示，自夏季高點以來，MSCI世界指數已下跌約3%，這與歷年期中選舉前的平均修正幅度吻合。Cau的團隊指出，歷史經驗顯示無須過度悲觀，因為股市通常在10月中旬(甚至在投票日之前)就會開始反彈回升。
在政局情勢方面，巴克萊公共政策分析師分析，當前基準情境為「分裂政府」，即民主黨較有望贏得眾議院，參議院則勢均力敵，而共和黨全面勝選(橫掃兩院)的機率最低。
民調與預測市場顯示，民主黨在通用選票上領先8個百分點，且有約60%的機率贏得兩院控制權。策略團隊認為，無論最終結果如何，對股市的實質影響均屬溫和。儘管國會未來可能加強對科技、醫療保健與銀行業的監管，並引發短期新聞頭條波動，但不大會改變產業基本面。
策略團隊補充，財政政策在分裂國會下可能微幅放寬，而貿易政策大幅變動的可能性極低。相較之下，策略團隊強調「油價與利率握有股市的命運」。
高殖利率與高油價持續施壓川普總統的施政滿意度，股票對這兩大因素的敏感度已轉為負面，這將促使政府更有動力控制能源價格。
在投資策略上，Cau的團隊建議採取中性Beta(中度風險)立場，優先布局銀行股、價值股及資本支出受惠類股，並搭配電信與公用事業等防禦性類股進行避險。至於輪動回歐洲市場或消費類股等週期性落後標的，則需等待油價與利率進一步穩定。
paras_en: Barclays says the equity market is currently following the typical seasonal pattern seen before historic midterm elections, but the actual impact of the election on policy and markets is expected to be relatively limited; oil prices and interest rates are the more decisive factors for future stock market direction.

Led by Emmanuel Cau, Barclays’ strategy team notes that since the summer peak the MSCI World Index has fallen about 3%, matching the average correction seen before past midterm elections. Cau’s team points out that history shows there is no need for excessive pessimism, as markets usually start to rebound in mid‑October (often even before Election Day).

Regarding the political landscape, Barclays public‑policy analysts see the baseline scenario as a ‘divided government’, with Democrats more likely to win the House, the Senate a toss‑up, and a full Republican sweep of both chambers the least likely outcome.

Polls and market forecasts show Democrats leading the generic ballot by eight points and having roughly a 60% chance of controlling both chambers. The strategy team believes that regardless of the final result, the substantive impact on equities will be modest. Even if Congress later tightens oversight of technology, healthcare and banking, causing short‑term headline volatility, the underlying industry fundamentals are unlikely to change.

The team adds that fiscal policy under a divided Congress may be slightly more accommodative, while the odds of a major shift in trade policy are very low. By contrast, they stress that “oil prices and interest rates hold the fate of the stock market.”

High yields and elevated oil prices continue to pressure President Trump’s approval ratings, making stocks increasingly sensitive to these two factors in a negative way, which should give the government more incentive to rein in energy prices.

For investment positioning, Cau’s team recommends a neutral‑beta (moderate‑risk) stance, favoring banks, value stocks and capital‑expenditure beneficiaries, while hedging with defensive sectors such as telecoms and utilities. Rotation into European markets or consumer‑cyclicals should wait until oil prices and rates stabilize.

items.title: AI撐起2026全球經濟！OECD警告能源衝擊恐拖累2027並推升通膨 美歐日等央行恐需進一步升息
items.title_en: AI Boosts the 2026 Global Economy! OECD Warns Energy Shock Could Drag Down 2027 Growth and Raise Inflation, Prompting Further Rate Hikes by Central Banks in the US, Europe, Japan and Others
paras: 經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)周三(23日)上修今年全球經濟成長預測至2.9%，主要歸功於人工智慧(AI)帶動的投資，但也表示，由於中東衝突引發的能源與大宗商品價格衝擊，2027年全球成長預測從3.1%降到3%。而且鑒於全球通膨將高於先前預期，從美國到澳洲等央行可能都需要進一步收緊貨幣政策。
總部位於巴黎的OECD在最新發布的臨時經濟展望中預估，2026年全球經濟成長率將為2.9%，略優於6月預估的2.8%。去年全球經濟成長3.4%。
展望2027年，中東衝突引發的大宗商品價格衝擊預料將拖累經濟動能，OECD預估全球經濟成長率僅回升至3.0%，低於6月預估的3.1%。
OECD表示，從資料中心到半導體的AI基礎設施支出強勁，是今年全球經濟展現韌性的關鍵支柱之一，這不僅推動美國經濟成長，也帶動日本與南韓科技出口。

能源衝擊升溫 OECD上修全球通膨預測

不過，OECD警告，全球經濟展望尤其受到能源市場動盪風險、強勁聖嬰現象(El Niño)引發的極端天氣、政府公債殖利率飆升，以及AI投資報酬令人失望等因素籠罩。
OECD估算，如果上述風險同時成真，明年全球經濟成長可能合計減少0.7個百分點，全球通膨率則可能提高1.1個百分點。
在OECD的基準展望中，G20經濟體2026年通膨率預估為4.1%，高於6月預估的4.0%，2027年預估值也從6月的3.1%上修至3.6%。
OECD表示，如果價格壓力擴大，或經濟成長失速，通膨升溫可能迫使各國央行調整利率政策。
OECD在報告中表示：「面對能源價格再度受到衝擊，以及需求壓力強於預期之際，加上許多經濟體的通膨率已高於目標，央行需要確保潛在通膨壓力得到持久控制。」
OECD的評估出爐之際，全球央行本月已掀起一波緊縮行動，美國聯準會(Fed)、歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BOJ)均在短短一周多的時間內升息。
OECD官員認為，未來還會有更多類似行動，但也表示，這波升息規模不會達到2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後各國採取的激進貨幣政策緊縮程度。
OECD預測，Fed今年還會升息一次，此外，歐元區、澳洲與南韓則會「進一步溫和升息」，日本則會「進一步升息」。相較之下，OECD表示，英國央行(BOE)與加拿大央行(BOC)目前將維持利率不變。

市場對升息次數看法分歧

這與投資人的看法略有不同。目前貨幣市場對Fed、ECB與BOE今年底前會再升息一次還是兩次，幾乎各半。
不過，交易員較確定日本今年底前只會再升息1次，同時也傾向認為加拿大將在這段期間升息1碼。
OECD表示，全球經濟成長路徑與6月相比大致沒有變化。相較於其他幅度有限的預測調整，加拿大與法國的展望下修較為突出。加拿大正面臨與美國的貿易戰，法國則面臨一段政治不穩定時期。
OECD表示：「全球經濟展望仍高度取決於中東衝突能否達成持久解決方案。貿易政策持續變動，包括關稅與出口限制，增加政策不確定性，並導致供應中斷。」

美中日歐展望分歧

在全球最大經濟體美國方面，OECD預估2026年經濟成長率為2.2%，2027年為2.1%，兩項預測均較6月上修。大量AI相關投資抵銷消費支出疲弱的影響，成為支撐美國經濟的主要力量。
美國2026年通膨率預估將達3.6%，2027年降至2.6%，關稅與能源價格上漲將壓縮家庭購買力，並推升企業成本。
中國經濟成長預估今年放緩至4.5%，2027年進一步降至4.2%，兩項預測均與6月相同。北京抑制過剩工業產能的措施將拖累投資，消費面臨通膨逐步上升帶來的壓力。
歐元區2026年與2027年經濟成長率均預估為1.0%。能源價格與利率走高將持續壓抑經濟活動，直到新增國防支出計畫開始提供支撐。
歐元區通膨率今年預估為3.0%，2027年為2.9%。天然氣價格上漲是推升通膨的部分原因，歐洲天然氣庫存水準在進入冬季供暖期前降至15年低點。
日本經濟預估2026年成長0.8%，2027年成長0.7%。升息與能源進口成本增加的影響，將抵銷強勁企業投資帶來的支撐。但與其他主要經濟體不同，日本通膨率預估將從今年的1.8%加速至2027年的2.6%，反映勞動市場緊俏與薪資強勁成長。
加拿大2026年經濟成長預測則從6月的1.2%下修至0.9%，2027年展望也從1.7%降至1.3%，主因美國對加拿大出口祭出新的關稅措施。
paras_en: The Organisation for Economic Co‑operation and Development (OECD) on Wednesday (the 23rd) raised its forecast for global economic growth this year to 2.9%, mainly thanks to investment driven by artificial intelligence (AI), but warned that the energy and commodity price shock triggered by the Middle‑East conflict would cut the 2027 global growth forecast from 3.1% to 3.0%. It also noted that, given global inflation is expected to be higher than previously thought, central banks from the United States to Australia may need to tighten monetary policy further.
Based in Paris, the OECD’s latest interim economic outlook estimates the global economy will grow at 2.9% in 2026, a shade above the 2.8% projected in June. Global growth was 3.4% last year.

Looking ahead to 2027, the commodity‑price shock stemming from the Middle‑East conflict is expected to dampen economic momentum, with the OECD forecasting global growth at only 3.0%, down from the 3.1% forecast made in June.

The OECD said that strong AI‑related infrastructure spending – from data centres to semiconductors – is one of the key pillars underpinning this year’s economic resilience, boosting growth in the United States and driving technology exports from Japan and South Korea.

Energy shock heats up: OECD lifts global inflation forecast. However, the OECD warned that the global outlook is especially clouded by risks from volatile energy markets, extreme weather linked to a strong El Niño, soaring sovereign‑bond yields and disappointing returns on AI investments.

The OECD estimates that if all of these risks materialise simultaneously, global growth could be reduced by a total of 0.7 percentage points next year and the global inflation rate could rise by 1.1 percentage points.
In the OECD’s baseline scenario, inflation in G20 economies is projected at 4.1% in 2026, up from the 4.0% forecast in June, and the 2027 estimate is revised from 3.1% to 3.6%.
The OECD said that if price pressures intensify or growth stalls, rising inflation could force central banks to adjust their rate policies.

The OECD report states: “Faced with renewed energy‑price shocks and demand pressures stronger than expected, coupled with many economies already seeing inflation above target, central banks need to ensure that underlying inflationary pressures remain under durable control.”

As the OECD’s assessment was released, central banks around the world have already launched a wave of tightening this month, with the US Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan all raising rates within just over a week.
OECD officials expect more such actions in the future, but say the current round of hikes will not reach the aggressive tightening seen after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

The OECD forecasts that the Fed will raise rates once more this year, while the euro‑area, Australia and South Korea will “further moderate” their hikes and Japan will “further raise” rates. By contrast, the OECD says the Bank of England and the Bank of Canada are likely to keep rates unchanged for now.

Market views on the number of rate hikes are split. This differs slightly from investors’ expectations, as money‑market participants are roughly evenly divided on whether the Fed, ECB and BOE will each deliver one or two more hikes before year‑end.
However, traders are more confident that Japan will only raise rates once more before year‑end and tend to think Canada will also deliver a single 25‑basis‑point hike in that period.

The OECD says the overall global growth path has not changed much since June. Compared with other modest forecast adjustments, the outlooks for Canada and France have been revised down more sharply. Canada faces a trade dispute with the United States, while France is dealing with a period of political instability.

The OECD adds: “The global economic outlook remains highly dependent on whether a lasting solution to the Middle‑East conflict can be achieved. Ongoing shifts in trade policy, including tariffs and export restrictions, increase policy uncertainty and cause supply disruptions.”

Diverging outlooks for the US, China, Japan and the euro area. For the United States, the OECD projects a 2.2% growth rate in 2026 and 2.1% in 2027, both revisions upward from June. Heavy AI‑related investment offsets weak consumer spending, becoming the main engine of US growth.
US inflation is forecast at 3.6% in 2026 and 2.6% in 2027, with tariffs and higher energy prices squeezing household purchasing power and pushing up corporate costs.

China’s growth forecast is slowed to 4.5% for this year and further to 4.2% in 2027, unchanged from June. Beijing’s measures to curb excess industrial capacity are expected to drag on investment, while consumption faces pressure from gradually rising inflation.

The euro area is projected to grow at 1.0% in both 2026 and 2027. Rising energy prices and higher interest rates will continue to suppress activity until new defence‑spending programmes begin to provide support.

Euro‑area inflation is forecast at 3.0% for this year and 2.9% in 2027. Higher natural‑gas prices are a key driver, with European gas inventories falling to a 15‑year low ahead of the winter heating season.

Japan’s economy is projected to grow 0.8% in 2026 and 0.7% in 2027. The impact of rate hikes and higher energy‑import costs will offset strong corporate investment, but unlike other major economies, Japan’s inflation is expected to accelerate from 1.8% this year to 2.6% in 2027, reflecting a tight labour market and robust wage growth.
Canada’s 2026 growth forecast has been cut from 1.2% in June to 0.9%, and the 2027 outlook lowered from 1.7% to 1.3%, mainly due to new US tariffs on Canadian exports.

items.title: 印尼央行維持基準利率5.75%不變 擴大避險誘因以穩定印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Keeps Benchmark Rate at 5.75% to Expand Hedging Incentives and Stabilize the Rupiah
paras: 印尼央行周三(23日)宣布將基準利率(7天期逆回購利率)維持在5.75%，為連續第三次按兵不動。隔夜存款利率與貸款利率分別維持於4.75%及6.5%。這是Destry Damayanti就任印尼央行首位女性總裁後的首次政策會議，決議符合市場預期。
印尼央行曾在今年5月與6月累計升息100個基點以捍衛匯率。總裁Damayanti表示，當前政策旨在維持印尼盾穩定、控制通膨並支撐經濟成長。
面對中東局勢、油價漲破每桶100美元及聯準會可能升息等外部不確定性，央行選擇採取非利率的創新政策工具，進一步調降外資避險成本(避險換匯貼息調降最高25%、國內無本金交割遠期外匯調降最高30%)，並採取「資金停留愈久、優惠愈高」的機制吸引外資流入。
決議公布後，印尼盾升值約0.4%至17,800對美元，股市大漲1.5%。
印尼8月通膨率升至3.19%，仍處於1.5%至3.5%的目標區間；央行維持2026年GDP成長預測於4.9%至5.7%不變。
市場對後續走勢看法分歧，巴克萊銀行預期利率將一路凍漲至2027年，但也有分析師認為，若高油價與聯準會升息壓力持續，央行第四季仍可能追加升息25個基點。
paras_en: Indonesia’s central bank on Wednesday (the 23rd) announced that it will keep the benchmark rate (the 7‑day reverse‑repo rate) at 5.75%, marking the third consecutive meeting of a hold. The overnight deposit rate and loan rate remain at 4.75% and 6.5% respectively. This was the first policy meeting after Destry Damayanti became the bank’s first female governor, and the decision matched market expectations.

The bank had raised rates by a total of 100 basis points in May and June of this year to defend the exchange rate. Governor Damayanti said the current policy aims to keep the rupiah stable, contain inflation and support economic growth.

Facing external uncertainties such as the Middle‑East situation, oil prices breaking $100 a barrel and the possibility of further Fed hikes, the central bank chose to use non‑rate innovative tools, further lowering the cost of hedging for foreign investors (reducing hedging‑exchange premium by up to 25% and domestic non‑deliverable forward premiums by up to 30%) and adopting a “the longer the funds stay, the higher the incentive” mechanism to attract foreign inflows.
After the decision was announced, the rupiah appreciated about 0.4% to around 17,800 per US dollar, and the stock market jumped 1.5%.
Indonesia’s August inflation rose to 3.19%, still within the 1.5%‑3.5% target band; the central bank kept its 2026 GDP growth forecast unchanged at 4.9%‑5.7%.

Market views on the next move diverge: Barclays expects rates to stay frozen until 2027, while some analysts argue that if high oil prices and Fed‑rate pressure persist, the bank could still add a 25‑basis‑point hike in the fourth quarter.

據波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯發文稱，因未來通貨膨脹持續高於2%目標的風險上升，支持FED上周加息，里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金亦稱，美國經濟越來越強勁，通貨膨脹風險仍占上風，但上周傳言日本曾對美元兌日圓詢價，此舉被視為當局入市干預的前兆，限制日圓走貶，並據美國總統川普表示，伊朗一直與美國進行接觸，認為兩國最終將達成協議，而且油價下跌，緩解通貨膨脹擔憂，打壓美元兌日圓至156.80低點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)總裁布雷曼表示，經濟復甦和通貨膨脹前景面臨風險，但澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁亨特重申，今年可能不得不第四次加息以控制通貨膨脹，並據RBA總裁布洛克稱，鑒於能源價格居高不下且國內需求持續過度，通貨膨脹面臨的上行風險可能正在顯現，市場分別加大押注RBA與RBNZ再加息，提振澳幣和紐元，而且消息人士透露，德國主要經濟研究機構包括WI研究所、伊福經濟研究所、IfW智庫、IWH以及DIW分別將今、明兩年經濟增長預期上調至1.3%及1.1%，帶動歐元兌美元盤整於1.1478高點。

隨後歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩表示，推高油氣價格的能源衝擊持續時間恐比ECB在3月預期的要長，地緣政治風險似乎再次升高，並據ECB指出，中國工業轉型正在將歐洲企業擠出全球市場，機械設備與運輸設備行業受影響尤為顯著，其中德國企業遭遇的衝擊最大，而且歐元區9月消費者信心指數較前月降1.0點至負16.5，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1428低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1450-70，支撐於1.1370-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國數據顯示8月公共部門借款達183億英鎊高於預期，並上修2026/27財政年前四個月借款數據，累計赤字再超出官方預測，增添財政大臣希首份預算案前壓力，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3387高點下滑。據英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布9月工業訂單差值升至負9，但伊朗提議重開荷姆茲海峽，推動油價下跌，減輕英國央行(BOE)升息壓力，導致英鎊兌美元跌至1.3318低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3340-60，支撐於1.3250-70。

Chicago Fed President Goolsbee and St. Louis Fed President Mussailem both advocated further rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (FED). They noted that President Trump is willing to meet Iran’s President Raisi at the UN General Assembly in New York, reviving hopes for renewed negotiations between the two countries, which pushed oil prices lower and boosted market sentiment. The Bank of Japan (BOJ) raised rates last week, but two members opposed the hike and there was no clear hawkish guidance, leading the market to bet that the BOJ will struggle to keep pace with major central banks, widening interest‑rate differentials and pressuring the yen. Tuesday was a Japanese holiday with thin trading, driving USD/JPY up to a high of 157.77.

Boston Fed President Collins wrote that the risk of inflation staying above the 2% target is rising, supporting the Fed’s rate hike last week. Richmond Fed President Barkin also said the U.S. economy is getting stronger and inflation risks remain dominant. Last week rumors surfaced that Japan had queried USD/JPY rates, seen as a pre‑emptive intervention to curb yen weakness. President Trump said Iran is in contact with the U.S. and expects a deal, and falling oil prices eased inflation concerns, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.80. The pair is expected to find support around 156.90‑157.10 and resistance near 157.80‑158.00.
EUR/USD

Yesterday the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) Governor Breman warned that the economic recovery and inflation outlook face risks, while RBA Deputy Governor Hunter reiterated that a fourth rate hike may be needed this year to tame inflation. RBA Governor Block added that persistent high energy prices and excess domestic demand are exposing upward inflation risks. Markets are increasing bets on further hikes by both the RBA and RBNZ, lifting the Australian and New Zealand dollars. items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Hovers Near 8-Week High as Fed Officials Emphasize Inflation Risks
paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Tuesday (the 22nd), continuing the boost from the Fed’s rate hike last week. The euro fell after weak consumer‑confidence data were released.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 100.54, its highest level since July 29.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted unanimously last Wednesday to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%. In addition, the Fed’s updated economic outlook summary showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sent a clear hawkish signal at the post‑decision press conference.
Higher‑rate environments generally favor a stronger dollar. Since the Fed’s hike, the dollar has gained nearly 1%.

Boston Fed President Susan Collins reiterated her support for the FOMC’s decision on Tuesday. In a social‑media post she stressed that elevated price pressures call for a more restrictive policy stance to achieve long‑term price stability.
She added that recent economic indicators suggest that after more than five years of persistently high costs, the likelihood of a scenario where “inflation is clearly above 2%” has increased.
Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin also backed the FOMC’s rate‑rise decision, noting that current inflation risks are higher than the risks posed by full employment.
Oil prices become a market focus

A major theme this month is central‑bank tightening driven by energy‑related price pressures, with both the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening policy. Against this backdrop, recent declines in oil prices have drawn attention from FX market participants.

Benchmark crude has fallen for five consecutive trading days, driven by easing concerns over supply disruptions and hopes for progress in Middle‑East diplomacy. Traders were encouraged by Saudi Arabia’s decisive actions to offset the impact of a key pipeline closure that was damaged during the expanded conflict with Iran‑backed Yemeni Houthi forces.

U.S. President Donald Trump’s possible meeting with the Iranian delegation, including its foreign minister and president, during the United Nations General Assembly this week has also lifted market sentiment. In a speech at the UN on Tuesday, Trump said he believes an agreement between Washington and Tehran will be reached after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “What’s happening this week could be pivotal for the medium‑term direction of crude prices, because the key players in the U.S.–Iran conflict will start talks in New York today. The agreements and consensus reached in those talks could determine whether the war escalates or a path out of the conflict is found.”

He noted, “The trajectory of oil prices will continue to affect global inflation and the policy choices of central banks. We have seen every major central bank (including the Fed) cite energy prices or ‘geopolitics’ as a driver for future decisions. That is the underlying reason for the recent hawkish rhetoric.”

Wizman added, “We still link higher oil prices with a stronger dollar against major currencies. This is not because high oil prices would force the Fed to hike rates; if oil rises further, all central banks would turn hawkish. The reason is that U.S. economic growth and the dollar benefit from improved trade terms and real‑income effects from higher oil prices. We believe the U.S.–Iran conflict, by keeping crude prices elevated, has become a key factor supporting the dollar’s strength this year.”
Euro weakens, yen slips slightly
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1448. Earlier data showed Euro‑area consumer confidence for September weakened from August, ending a four‑month streak of improvement.

On the other hand, after the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last week, the yen briefly accelerated its depreciation but has now paused, with little change in the exchange rate. The dollar/yen is slightly above the flat level at 157.38.

Because Japan is entering a continuous holiday period, Asian trading volumes are low. FX allocation firms warn that this seasonal lull can amplify market volatility and the impact of central‑bank actions.

The Nikkei reported that the BOJ has conducted a formal “exchange‑rate inquiry” with the FX trading desk, heightening market anxiety. The procedure involves central‑bank officials calling commercial banks to request real‑time executable rate quotes.

Although the yen has continued to weaken after the BOJ’s non‑consensus 25‑basis‑point hike, pushing borrowing costs to a 31‑year high, market strategists point out that Tokyo still wields massive policy firepower. Japan holds roughly $1 trillion in foreign‑exchange reserves, providing ample liquidity to authorities.

items.title: 〈台幣〉交投熱絡處續強格局 升值5分收31.708元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Keeps Strong Appreciation Trend, Gains 0.05 to Close at 31.708
paras: 新台幣今(22)日維持續強升值格局，終場收在31.708元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值達20.13億美元相對大量區。
新台幣今日以31.74元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.658元，全日均處升值態勢，高低價差9分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元續強升值達0.8%，新台幣收升0.16%，星元和人民幣則貶0.05%左右，日元和泰銖續挫逾0.2%，美元指數反彈達0.15%。
元大投顧表示，隨著國際原油、債券殖利率回落，市場風險偏好轉強，帶動科技族群走揚。
國泰證期研究部也說明，中東局勢雖因青年運動攻擊沙國而緊張，但川普釋出與伊朗會面意願，油價回落且 10 年期美債殖利率降至 4.951%、30 年期降至 5.284%，加上美國財長貝森特已會晤何立峰，為即將登場的川習會鋪路，舒緩市場對通膨升息及地緣政治的疑慮。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong appreciation trend today (22nd), closing at 31.708, up 0.05, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms’ transaction volume reaching US$2.013 billion in the large‑volume segment.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.74, up 0.018, then rose to a high of 31.658, staying in appreciation throughout the day, with a high‑low spread of 0.09.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won continued to appreciate by 0.8%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.16%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each weakened about 0.05%, the Japanese yen and Thai baht each fell more than 0.2%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded 0.15%.
Yuanta Investment Advisory said that as international crude‑oil prices and bond yields retreat, market risk appetite strengthens, boosting the technology sector.

Cathay Securities Research explained that although Middle‑East tensions have risen due to a youth‑movement attack on Saudi Arabia, President Trump signaled willingness to meet Iran, oil prices have fallen and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield has dropped to 4.951% and the 30‑year to 5.284%. In addition, U.S. Treasury Secretary Besson has met with He Lifeng, paving the way for the upcoming Trump‑Xi summit and easing market concerns about inflation‑driven rate hikes and geopolitical risks.

items.title: 油價回落與半導體出口強勁 韓元大漲1.5%領跑亞幣
items.title_en: Oil price drop and strong semiconductor exports, Won jumps 1.5% leading Asian currencies
paras: 受到國際油價急跌、南韓出口數據強勁及外資湧入等多重利多帶動，韓元兌美元匯率周二(22日)顯著走揚，韓元單日漲幅一度擴大至1.5%，來到1,352.90韓元兌1美元，創下五周以來最大單日升幅，表現大幅跑贏其他亞洲貨幣。
市場數據顯示，韓元兌美元當日開盤報1,371韓元，較前一交易日收盤價升約0.67%。隨後匯率迅速突破1,360韓元關卡。分析人士指出，適逢中秋假期臨近，南韓主要出口企業集中拋售美元，加上外資大舉買入南韓股票與美股強勁反彈，帶動整體市場風險偏好回溫。
國際局勢方面，美伊局勢出現對話跡象，國際油價連續3日下挫，布蘭特原油期貨下跌3.4%至每桶100.34美元，西德州原油(WTI)亦重挫4.5%跌破100美元關卡，帶來股市及韓元匯市利多。
南韓周一公布9月前20天出口額年增高達78%，其中半導體出貨大幅激增259%，帶來龐大的美元資金流入。此外，美元買盤減弱，美國10年期國債殖利率回落至5%以下，緩解了美元的升值壓力。
友利銀行(Woori Bank)分析師閔庚源表示，風險偏好回升有利於出口商結匯拋售美元，進一步拉低匯率。然而，全球高利率環境與美元整體強勢，仍可能是限制韓元後續升值空間的潛在因素。
paras_en: Benefiting from a sharp fall in international oil prices, robust South Korean export data and inflows of foreign capital, the Korean won surged significantly against the US dollar on Tuesday (the 22nd). The one‑day gain briefly widened to 1.5%, reaching 1,352.90 won per dollar, marking the largest single‑day rise in five weeks and far outpacing other Asian currencies.

Market data showed the won opened at 1,371 per dollar, about 0.67% higher than the previous close. The rate then quickly broke the 1,360‑won barrier. Analysts noted that with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching, major South Korean exporters were selling dollars en masse, while foreign investors were buying South Korean stocks and US equities rebounded strongly, boosting overall market risk appetite.

On the geopolitical front, signs of dialogue emerged between the US and Iran, and international oil prices fell for three consecutive days. Brent crude futures dropped 3.4% to $100.34 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate slid 4.5% below the $100 mark, providing a boost to both equity markets and the won exchange market.

South Korea reported on Monday that export value for the first 20 days of September rose 78% year‑on‑year, with semiconductor shipments surging 259%, bringing in a massive inflow of US dollars. At the same time, dollar buying pressure eased and the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury fell below 5%, relieving upward pressure on the dollar.

Woori Bank analyst Min Gyeong‑won said that the revival of risk appetite benefits exporters who convert earnings and sell dollars, further pushing the won lower. However, the global high‑interest‑rate environment and the overall strength of the dollar could still limit the won’s upside potential.

U.S. August manufacturing output unexpectedly fell month‑on‑month. Rising oil prices and higher rates may outweigh AI‑driven support, keeping manufacturing activity modest for the rest of the year. Meanwhile the market hopes diplomatic breakthroughs on the Iran war during this week’s UN session, and Saudi oil shipments have partially resumed despite ongoing Houthi attacks in Yemen, pushing oil prices down and reducing dollar‑safe‑haven buying. In addition, the Bank of Japan raised rates to 1.25% as expected last Monday, but two board members voted against it and there was no clear hawkish guidance. Disappointed investors briefly pushed USD/JPY above 158, a two‑week high, before Japanese authorities reportedly queried the FX market and CFTC data showed net long yen positions surged to the highest level since July 2025 as of the week ending 15 Sept. Because Monday‑Wednesday were Japanese holidays, trading was thin, and investors feared the government might intervene amid low liquidity to support the yen, pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 156.56.

Later, U.S. officials released the August national activity index at –0.04. Treasury Secretary B. said President Trump and the Treasury remain confident in Fed Chair Waller, and Chicago Fed President Goolsbee said strong demand is fuelling inflation, possibly prompting faster rate hikes, lifting USD/JPY to a high of 157.52. The dollar is expected to find support today around 156.90‑157.10, with resistance at 157.80‑158.00.
EUR/USD

Saudi Arabia loaded about 14 million barrels of crude onto seven VLCCs in the Gulf, signalling a partial rebound in Saudi oil shipments and boosting market risk appetite. Meanwhile, the Commonwealth Bank of Australia and ANZ revised their rate forecasts on Monday, expecting the Reserve Bank of Australia to raise rates next Tuesday. All four major Australian banks now anticipate an RBA hike to 4.6% next week, supporting the Aussie and keeping EUR/USD flat near the 1.1495 high.

Voting forecasts show Germany’s far‑right AfD topped the vote in the northeastern state elections on Sunday, delivering the worst result for Chancellor Merkel’s mainstream conservative party since 1949. The ECB’s economic report warned that a surge in gas prices could push euro‑area inflation higher faster than before, but a higher share of renewable generation will temper electricity price impacts, pulling EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1461. Today’s EUR/USD resistance is projected at 1.1480‑1.1500, support at 1.1410‑1.1430.

UK property portal Rightmove reported on Monday that asking prices for new listings rose 0.7% from the previous month between 9 Aug and 12 Sep, the first price increase by sellers since May. After a particularly weak summer, the above‑average September price rise is a welcome signal, supporting the pound up to a high of 1.3400 against the dollar.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近8周高點 歐元因德國政局受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.

items.title: 日本救日元反成賣點！瑞銀資管等再度干預伺機賣出
items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”
